Dual Activation and C–N Coupling of CO 2 and N 2 Mediated by Small Fe n + Clusters
abstractText: Abstract We present a combined experimental and theoretical study on how small iron clusters activate dinitrogen (N2) and carbon dioxide (CO2) under ambient conditions. Mass spectrometry shows these clusters can cleave the N≡N triple bond, producing a range of odd-nitrogen species, with Fe3N7+ and Fe4N7+ appearing as major products. Introducing CO2 into the downstream flow-tube reactor yields distinct FenNmCO+ and FenNmO+ species, indicating that the CO2 also undergoes C═O bond dissociation under this condition. Thermodynamics and kinetics analyses reveal that the formation of Fe3,4N5CO+ proceeds via C–N coupling pathways and generates a stable N2O molecule. The empty d orbitals of Fe atoms facilitate the coordination of N2 and CO2; meanwhile, not only Fen+ but also the Fe3,4N7+ clusters exhibit delocalized electrons and superatomic states. This allows the half-filled superatomic P orbital to engage in superatom–atom bonding with carbon and oxygen atoms, thereby modifying the covalent coordination and active sites for reactions with N2 and CO2. These findings advance mechanistic insight into nitrogen fixation by iron clusters─highlighting the role of electron delocalization─and point to a promising route of plasma-assisted catalytic conversion of atmospheric CO2 and N2 into value-added products under mild conditions.

abstractText: Phân tích kết quả triển khai áp dụng mô hình dự đoán nguy cơ trong giám sát biến cố bất lợi giảm tiểu cầu liên quan linezolid thông qua hoạt động dược lâm sàng tại Bệnh viện Phổi Trung ương. Nghiên cứu tiến cứu, một nhóm, mô tả tính khả thi và kết quả thực hiện từ tháng 02-11/2025 trên người bệnh nội trú từ 18 tuổi trở lên được chỉ định linezolid 600 mg mỗi 12 giờ để điều trị nhiễm khuẩn ngoài lao. Tại thời điểm duyệt phiếu yêu cầu sử dụng kháng sinh, dược sĩ lâm sàng (DSLS) phân tầng người bệnh thành ba nhóm nguy cơ giảm tiểu cầu (thấp, trung bình, cao) và đề xuất can thiệp tương ứng. 73 người bệnh có phiếu yêu cầu sử dụng linezolid và được phân tầng nguy cơ giảm tiểu cầu. 72,6% được dự đoán nguy cơ thấp, nguy cơ trung bình 19,2% và cao 8,2%. Tất cả người bệnh đều được khuyến cáo tần suất theo dõi công thức máu với tỷ lệ đồng thuận của bác sĩ là 100%. Tỷ lệ ghi nhận biến cố giảm tiểu cầu là 17,8%. title: ವಚನಕರರ ಪರಮಣ ಮಮಸ
abstractText: ವಚನಕಾರರ ಜ್ಞಾನಮೀಮಾಂಸೆಯು ಭಾರತೀಯ ದಾರ್ಶನಿಕ ಪರಂಪರೆಗಳ ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಜ್ಞಾನಮಾರ್ಗಗಳಿಗಿಂತ ತೀರಾ ಭಿನ್ನವಾದ ಹಾಗೂ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟವಾದ ನೆಲೆಯನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದೆ. ಪ್ರತ್ಯಕ್ಷ, ಅನುಮಾನ, ಶಬ್ದ ಮತ್ತು ಉಪಮಾನ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಗಳನ್ನು ವಚನಕಾರರು ಜಡ ಹಾಗೂ ಸ್ಥಿರ ಸಾಧನಗಳೆಂದು ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಭಾಷೆಯ ಮಿತಿಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ವೇದ, ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ, ಪುರಾಣಗಳಂತಹ ಶಬ್ದಪ್ರಮಾಣಗಳು ಕಾಲಾನಂತರದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಅಸಮಾನತೆಯನ್ನು ಪೋಷಿಸಿದ ಕಾರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಅವುಗಳನ್ನು ಕಟುವಾಗಿ ನಿರಾಕರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಬದಲಾಗಿ, ನಿರಂತರ ಚಲನಶೀಲವಾದ ‘ಅನುಭಾವ’ವನ್ನೇ ಅವರು ಪರಮ ಪ್ರಮಾಣವೆಂದು ಒಪ್ಪುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಇಂದ್ರಿಯಗಳ ಮಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಅರಿತಿದ್ದ ಅವರು, ಹಳೆಯ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಗಳನ್ನು ಕೆಡವುತ್ತಾ ಷಟ್ಸ್ಥಲ, ಅಷ್ಟಾವರಣಗಳಂತಹ ಹೊಸ ಚಲನಶೀಲ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಗಳನ್ನು ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸಿದರು. ಹೀಗೆ ರಚನೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರಚನೆಯ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಲೋಕವನ್ನು ಗ್ರಹಿಸಿದರೂ, ಅಂತಿಮವಾಗಿ ಪರಶಿವ ಅಥವಾ ಪರತತ್ವವನ್ನು ‘ಅಪ್ರಮಾಣ’, ‘ಅಗಮ್ಯ’ ಹಾಗೂ ‘ಅಗೋಚರ’ ಎಂದೇ ದಾರ್ಶನಿಕವಾಗಿ ಪ್ರತಿಪಾದಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಇದು ವಚನಕಾರರ ತರ್ಕಾತೀತವಾದ ಹಾಗೂ ಅನುಭಾವಿಕವಾದ ನಿಲುವನ್ನು ಎತ್ತಿಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.

title: VdGGCT, a GGCT-like superfamily protein, is required for mycelial growth, conidiation, and pathogenicity of Verticillium dahliae
abstractText: Abstract Given the scarcity of known virulence factors in Verticillium dahliae , a fungus that causes severe agricultural losses worldwide, identifying novel virulence genes is essential for understanding its pathogenic mechanisms and ultimately for developing effective disease control strategies. Gamma-glutamyl cyclotransferase (GGCT) has been recognized as a promising drug target, yet its biological functions and regulatory roles in plant-pathogenic fungi remain largely unexplored. Here, we demonstrate that knockout of the VdGGCT gene severely attenuates the development and virulence of V. dahliae and increases resistance to diamide (Dia)-induced oxidative stress. Functional assays using the organic sulfur auxotrophic yeast mutant ABC1723 revealed that despite belonging to the GGCT superfamily, VdGGCT does not exhibit detectable GGCT activity towards GSH, γ-Glu-Met, or γ-Glu-Cys. Integrative transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses revealed that the deletion of VdGGCT significantly downregulated the expression of glutamate and γ-glutamyl amino acids in the γ-glutamyl cycle, with concordant dysregulation of arginine/proline and beta-alanine metabolism at both levels, indicating that VdGGCT modulates the expression and abundance of genes related to pathogenicity, especially in the γ-glutamyl cycle and amino acid metabolism pathways. Collectively, these findings highlight the importance of VdGGCT in the development, oxidative stress response, and virulence of V. dahliae , identifying it as a novel potential target for designing innovative fungicides.

Predicting Ground Granulated Blast-Furnace Slag (GGBS) Concrete Strength Based On PerformanceWith Interpretable Artificial Neural Networks (ANN)
abstractText: Accurate prediction of concrete strength is essential for effective mix proportioning, performance optimisation, and sustainable construction. Conventional empirical and regression–based approaches often have limited capability to capture the complex and nonlinear interactions among constituent materials, particularly in blended and geopolymer concrete systems. This study develops an Artificial Neural Network (ANN)–based machine learning framework for predicting the compressive and flexural strengths of GGBS–based concrete. A dataset comprising 150 concrete mixtures with varying binder compositions, material proportions, and curing periods was employed to develop and evaluate the predictive models. The modelling framework was assessed using k–fold cross–validation, statistical error indicators, \ and residual diagnostics to examine prediction accuracy, robustness, and generalisation capability. The ANN model demonstrated excellent predictive performance for compressive strength, achieving high coefficients of determination and low prediction errors across the training, validation, and testing datasets. In comparison, the prediction of flexural strength showed relatively lower generalisation performance, which may be attributed to greater experimental variability and the sensitivity of flexural behaviour to crack initiation, propagation, aggregate–matrix interaction, and material heterogeneity. To improve model interpretability, SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) analysis was employed to quantify the contribution of individual input variables. The results identified GGBS content and the alkali–to–binder ratio as the dominant factors influencing predicted strength, demonstrating consistency with the underlying chemical and mechanical behaviour of GGBS–based concrete. The integrated ANN–SHAP framework provides both accurate prediction and meaningful interpretation of strength development. Overall, the findings demonstrate that ANN based machine learning can serve as a reliable and efficient tool for strength prediction and performance–based optimisation of GGBS–based concrete, potentially reducing the need for extensive experimental trials while saving time, material consumption, and associated costs.

title: Adverse Drug Reaction Detection with Drug Prediction Using BERT–LSTM–SVM
abstractText: Social media can be a useful resource for assessing patient-reported drug experiences. Adverse drug reactions (ADRs) are an important public health issue, but finding social media posts in which adverse reactions are described is a difficult task, since not all posts are related to ADR. The proposed work in this research is a hybrid model of BERT-LSTM-SVM for detection of ADRs and drug classification. The input is preprocessed as follows: the text is cleaned, tokenized, normalized, and noise is removed. Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) is used to produce contextual representations of the text, and a Long Short-Term Memory network (LSTM) is used to model sequential dependencies to aid binary classification of ADR and non-ADR text. Then, a Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier is used to classify the associated medicine based on the extracted textual features. In our validation of the method, the accuracy, sensitivity, specificity and precision were 0.99 with a recall. The proposed framework combines contextual language representations, sequential modeling, and supervised classification approaches to facilitate the automatic detection of ADRs and medicine identification.

title: Quality, WHO guideline concordance and viewer reception of Turkish-language YouTube videos on complementary feeding: a mixed-methods study
abstractText: Abstract Background Introducing complementary foods between 6 and 23 months is a critical window, and caregivers increasingly rely on video platforms for guidance. Previous appraisals assessed generic quality rather than concordance with specific recommendations, focused on English-language content, and didn’t examine how viewers receive it. We appraised the quality, reliability, and guideline concordance of Turkish-language YouTube complementary-feeding videos and analyzed viewers’ comments. Methods The 20 most relevant videos for each of three Turkish search terms (60 videos) were assessed with four validated instruments (GQS, VIQI, mDISCERN, and JAMA benchmark criteria) and a guideline coverage score (0–10) based on five strong recommendations from the 2023 WHO guideline. Two raters scored all videos independently and reconciled by consensus (inter-rater reliability ICC 0.79–0.95, except the JAMA benchmark, 0.46); non-parametric tests with Benjamini–Hochberg correction were used. The first 20 comments per video (298 comments from 26 videos) underwent thematic analysis. Results The four quality instruments were moderately-to-strongly intercorrelated (Spearman’s ρ = 0.51–0.77). The key finding was a between-group difference: as a group, complementary-food videos scored highest on quality but lowest on guideline coverage (large effect sizes), despite predominantly physician authorship, while underrepresenting continued breastfeeding, dietary diversity, and avoiding unhealthy foods and drinks. The inverse quality–coverage correlations across all videos (ρ=−0.28 to − 0.42) reflected this between-group separation, not a within-video relationship: they didn’t persist after adjustment for search-term group, and within the complementary-food group they were positive. Thematic analysis identified four themes: responses were appreciative rather than evaluative, with no comment engaging the evidence base; over half expressed persisting uncertainty about practical feeding decisions; a substantial group positioned the channel as a source of clinical guidance; and many disclosed parental burden that the videos were said to relieve. Conclusions Apparent quality, professional authorship, and popularity didn’t track concordance with guidance. In their comments, viewers responded largely to clarity rather than accuracy, and some described relying on the channel as a primary source of feeding guidance. Because complementary feeding is anchored in explicit guidance, concordance can be measured and the omitted messages named, giving clinicians, creators and platforms specific targets for safer online infant-feeding information.

title: ಕರನಟಕದ ರಜಕಯ ಮತತ ಸಮಜಕ ಪರವರತನಯಲಲ ಕನನಡ ಸಹತಯದ ಪತರ: ಒದ ಅಧಯಯನ
abstractText: ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯವು ಸಮಾಜದ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ, ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ಬದುಕಿನ ಪ್ರತಿಬಿಂಬ ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲದೆ, ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಪ್ರಜ್ಞೆಯನ್ನು ರೂಪಿಸುವ ಹಾಗೂ ಸಮಾಜದ ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆಗೆ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆ ನೀಡುವ ಸಾಧನವಾಗಿದೆ. ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯವು ಕಲಾತ್ಮಕ ಅಭಿವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಮಾಧ್ಯಮವನ್ನು ಮೀರಿ ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಜಾಗೃತಿ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಸುಧಾರಣೆ, ಸಮಾನತೆ, ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಜಾಸತ್ತಾತ್ಮಕ ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾಗವಹಿಸಲು ಉತ್ತೇಜಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಶಕ್ತಿಯಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿದೆ. ಹನ್ನೆರಡನೇ ಶತಮಾನದ ವಚನ ಚಳವಳಿಯಿಂದ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭವಾಗಿ ಪ್ರಗತಿಶೀಲ, ನವ್ಯ, ಬಂಡಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ದಲಿತ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ಚಳವಳಿಗಳವರೆಗೆ ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯವು ಸಮಾಜದಲ್ಲಿನ ಅಸಮಾನತೆ, ಜಾತಿ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ, ಅಸ್ಪೃಶ್ಯತೆ, ಲಿಂಗ ತಾರತಮ್ಯ, ಶೋಷಣೆ, ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಅಧಿಕಾರದ ದುರುಪಯೋಗ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಬಹಿಷ್ಕಾರಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರಶ್ನಿಸುವ ಮೂಲಕ ತನ್ನ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿಯನ್ನು ವ್ಯಕ್ತಪಡಿಸಿದೆ.ಈ ಸಂಶೋಧನಾ ಲೇಖನದಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯವು ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಸುಧಾರಣೆಗೆ ನೀಡಿದ ಕೊಡುಗೆಯನ್ನು ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣಾತ್ಮಕ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಕೋನದಿಂದ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ನಡೆಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಬಸವಣ್ಣ, ಕುವೆಂಪು, ಡಿ. ಆರ್. ಬೇಂದ್ರೆ, ಯು. ಆರ್. ಅನಂತಮೂರ್ತಿ, ಸಿದ್ದಲಿಂಗಯ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ದೇವನೂರು ಮಹಾದೇವ ಮುಂತಾದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಸಾಹಿತಿಗಳ ಚಿಂತನೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯಿಕ ಕೊಡುಗೆಗಳನ್ನು ಅಧ್ಯಯನಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಆಧಾರವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ವಚನ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯವು ಸಮಾನತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಯಕದ ಗೌರವವನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿಪಾದಿಸಿದರೆ, ಪ್ರಗತಿಶೀಲ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯವು ಬಡತನ ಮತ್ತು ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಶೋಷಣೆಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರಶ್ನಿಸಿತ್ತು. ನವ್ಯ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯವು ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ, ಸಮಾಜ, ಪರಂಪರೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅಧಿಕಾರದ ನಡುವಿನ ಸಂಘರ್ಷಗಳನ್ನು ವಿಮರ್ಶಾತ್ಮಕವಾಗಿ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಿಸಿತು. ಬಂಡಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ದಲಿತ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯವು ಕೆಳಸಮುದಾಯಗಳ ಧ್ವನಿಯನ್ನು ತೆರೆಯುವ ಮೂಲಕ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯ ಮತ್ತು ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಸಬಲೀಕರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊಸ ಆಯಾಮ ನೀಡಿತು.ಈ ಅಧ್ಯಯನವು ಗುಣಾತ್ಮಕ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣಾತ್ಮಕ ಸಂಶೋಧನಾ ವಿಧಾನವನ್ನು ಅಳವಡಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದು, ಪುಸ್ತಕಗಳು, ಸಂಶೋಧನಾ ಲೇಖನಗಳು, ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ವಿಮರ್ಶೆಗಳು, ಐತಿಹಾಸಿಕ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಇತರ ಮೂಲಗಳನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿ ವಿಷಯಾಧಾರಿತ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ ನಡೆಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯವು ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಜಾಗೃತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಸುಧಾರಣೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಗಮನಾರ್ಹ ಪ್ರಭಾವ ಬೀರಿದೆ ಎಂಬುದು ಅಧ್ಯಯನದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಅಂಶವಾಗಿದೆ. ಸಮಕಾಲೀನ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯವು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ನ್ಯಾಯ, ಮಾನವ ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳು, ಪರಿಸರ, ಲಿಂಗ ಸಮಾನತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಜಾಸತ್ತಾತ್ಮಕ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳ ಕುರಿತು ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಚರ್ಚೆಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಲು ಕಾರಣವಾಗಿದೆ.

title: KẾT QUẢ QUẢN LÝ ĐIỀU TRỊ BỆNH NHÂN BỆNH PHỔI TẮC NGHẼN MẠN TÍNH TẠI TRUNG TÂM Y TẾ KHU VỰC CẨM KHÊ, TỈNH PHÚ THỌ
abstractText: Mục tiêu: Mô tả đặc điểm lâm sàng, cận lâm sàng và đánh giá kết quả quản lý điều trị bệnh phổi tắc nghẽn mạn tính (COPD) cùng một số yếu tố liên quan ở người bệnh quản lý ngoại trú tại Trung tâm Y tế khu vực Cẩm Khê, tỉnh Phú Thọ. Đối tượng và phương pháp: Nghiên cứu mô tả cắt ngang, có theo dõi dọc trên 102 người bệnh COPD được chẩn đoán theo tiêu chuẩn GOLD, quản lý điều trị ngoại trú tại Trung tâm Y tế khu vực Cẩm Khê, tỉnh Phú Thọ, từ tháng 6/2025 đến tháng 6/2026, so sánh hai thời điểm ban đầu (T0) và sau 3 tháng (T3). Kết quả: Tuổi trung bình 71,1 ± 10,6, nam giới chiếm 70,6%. GOLD 2 - 3 chiếm 72,5%; nhóm ABE-E chiếm 59,8%; điểm CAT trung bình 21,8 ± 4,9, điểm mMRC trung bình 3,3 ± 0,8. Sau 3 tháng, 53,9% không xuất hiện đợt cấp, 42,2% cải thiện điểm CAT và 30,4% cải thiện điểm mMRC; 16,7% đạt đồng thời cả ba tiêu chí. Tuổi ≥ 60 làm giảm khả năng cải thiện CAT (aOR = 0,23; 95%CI 0,05 - 0,93; p = 0,040) và thời gian mắc bệnh ≥ 15 năm làm giảm khả năng không xuất hiện đợt cấp (aOR = 0,35; 95%CI 0,14 - 0,89; p = 0,027). Kết luận: Quản lý điều trị ngoại trú COPD tại tuyến y tế khu vực đạt kết quả khả quan về kiểm soát đợt cấp, song tỷ lệ đạt đồng thời cả ba tiêu chí điều trị còn thấp. Tuổi cao và thời gian mắc bệnh kéo dài là hai yếu tố tiên lượng độc lập cần được lưu ý trong theo dõi và phân tầng nguy cơ.

title: Treatment Outcomes and Predictors of Relative Dose Intensity Among Patients Receiving Chemotherapy for Colorectal Cancer in Nakuru County, Kenya: a Retrospective Cohort Study
abstractText: Colorectal cancer is an increasing cause of cancer morbidity and mortality in Africa, where late diagnosis and constrained oncology services may compromise treatment delivery. Relative dose intensity is an important measure of chemotherapy delivery, but evidence describing its predictors and relationship with outcomes in Kenyan public oncology practice remains limited. The aim of the study was to determine chemotherapy RDI, identify factors associated with achieving optimal RDI, evaluate treatment response and survival, and examine the relationship between RDI and treatment outcomes among patients with colorectal cancer receiving chemotherapy at a county referral hospital in Kenya. A retrospective cohort study was conducted using records of adults with colorectal cancer treated between January 2020 and December 2024 at Nakuru County Referral Hospital. A simple random sample was drawn from 300 eligible records; 186 records were selected, and 185 complete records were analysed. Data were abstracted using a structured tool. RDI was calculated as the actual dose intensity divided by the planned dose intensity × 100 and classified as optimal (≥85%) or suboptimal (<85%). Descriptive statistics, chi-square tests, binary logistic regression, Kaplan-Meier analysis, log-rank tests, and unadjusted Cox regression were performed using SPSS version 26. The mean RDI was 82.95% (SD 5.35; range 60.0-98.0%), with 44.9% achieving optimal RDI and 55.1% suboptimal RDI. Treatment delays occurred in 91.9% of patients, with toxicity the most common reason; dose reductions or adjustments occurred in 42.7%. Age group, dose reduction/adjustment (AOR 0.34, 95% CI 0.13-0.87; p = 0.025), and treatment response (overall p = 0.007) were independently associated with optimal RDI. Median overall survival was 15 months for suboptimal RDI and not reached for optimal RDI (HR 0.093, 95% CI 0.052-0.168). Corresponding progression-free survival results were 14 months and not reached (HR 0.103, 95% CI 0.060-0.179). Suboptimal chemotherapy RDI was common, characterised by frequent treatment delays and dose modification. Optimal RDI was strongly associated with better observed survival, although the unadjusted survival analyses do not establish causality. Routine toxicity management, treatment schedule monitoring, medication availability, and RDI monitoring may help strengthen chemotherapy delivery in comparable resource-constrained settings.

title: AN ANALYSIS OF STUDENT’S PERCEPTIONS ON ENGLISH FOR SPECIFIC PURPOSES (ESP) MATERIALS IN ENGLISH TEXTBOOK USE IN VOCATIONAL SCHOOL
abstractText: This descriptive qualitative study aims to evaluate the alignment of English for Specific Purposes (ESP) materials in the textbook English for Professional Hotel Staff with hospitality students' vocational demands and explore students' subjective perceptions of the materials. Data were gathered through document analysis of Units 1–7 employing a materials evaluation checklist and a focus group discussion with 10 hospitality students at a vocational high school. The document analysis revealed that the textbook consistently presents industry-relevant vocabulary and workplace communicative functions, yet it exhibits an imbalance in language skills where listening and writing are underrepresented alongside irregular authentic materials. The focus group discussion showed that 8 out of 10 students perceived the content as partially relevant to entry-level tasks, 7 students deemed it fundamentally useful but insufficient for workplace readiness, and their classroom engagement was conditional with a strong preference for hands-on role-play activities. These convergent findings indicate that while the textbook offers a solid instructional basis, supplementary authentic tasks and pedagogical adaptations are necessary to foster comprehensive occupational competence. ABSTRAK Penelitian kualitatif deskriptif ini bertujuan untuk mengevaluasi kesesuaian materi English for Specific Purposes (ESP) dalam buku teks English for Professional Hotel Staff terhadap kebutuhan vokasi siswa perhotelan sekaligus menganalisis persepsi siswa terhadap materi tersebut. Data dihimpun melalui analisis dokumen terhadap Unit 1–7 dengan panduan kerangka evaluasi bahan ajar serta diskusi kelompok terpumpun (focus group discussion) bersama 10 siswa perhotelan di sekolah menengah kejuruan. Hasil analisis dokumen menunjukkan bahwa materi menyajikan kosakata perhotelan dan fungsi bahasa yang sesuai dengan tugas kerja secara konsisten, namun cakupan empat keterampilan bahasa belum seimbang karena keterampilan menyimak dan menulis kurang terwakili serta materi autentik masih minim. Hasil diskusi kelompok terpumpun mengungkap bahwa 8 dari 10 siswa menilai materi relevan secara parsial pada tingkat dasar, 7 siswa memandang materi berguna namun belum memadai untuk kesiapan kerja industri, dan keterlibatan belajar siswa bersifat kondisional dengan preferensi tertinggi pada aktivitas simulasi kerja (role-play). Kedua temuan mengonfirmasi bahwa buku teks ini berfungsi sebagai fondasi awal yang baik namun memerlukan materi suplemen autentik dan variasi tugas untuk mengoptimalkan kompetensi komunikasi kerja siswa.

abstractText: ವಚನಕಾರ್ತಿಯರ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ‘ಭಕ್ತಿ’ಯ ಕಲ್ಪನೆಯು ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಆಚರಣಾತ್ಮಕ ನೆಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮೀರಿ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ರೂಪಕವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿದೆ. ಉಪನಿಷತ್ತು ಹಾಗೂ ಪುರಾಣಗಳ ಕಾಲದ ಕರ್ಮಠ ಭಕ್ತಿಯ ವ್ಯಾಖ್ಯಾನಗಳನ್ನು ಬದಿಗೊತ್ತಿ, ಶರಣೆಯರು ಕಾಯಕ, ದೇಹ ಮತ್ತು ಅನುಭಾವಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಭಕ್ತಿಗೆ ಹೊಸ ಭಾಷ್ಯ ಬರೆದರು. ಅಕ್ಕಮಹಾದೇವಿ, ಮೋಳಿಗೆ ಮಹಾದೇವಿ, ಅಮ್ಮುಗೆ ರಾಯಮ್ಮ ಮುಂತಾದವರು ಗುಡಿ-ಗೋಪುರಗಳ ಸ್ಥಾವರ ಭಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸಿ, ‘ದೇಹವೇ ದೇಗುಲ’ ಎಂಬ ತತ್ವವನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿಪಾದಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಪ್ರಾಪಂಚಿಕ ಡಂಬಾಚಾರಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ವ್ರತ-ನೇಮಗಳನ್ನು ಅಲ್ಲಗಳೆದು, ದೈನಂದಿನ ಬದುಕು, ವೃತ್ತಿ ನಿಷ್ಠೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಯಕಗಳಲ್ಲೇ ದೇವರನ್ನು ಕಾಣುವ ಅವರ ನಿಲುವುಗಳು ಅನನ್ಯವಾಗಿವೆ. ಭಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಕೇವಲ ಪೂಜಾವಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ನೋಡದೆ, ಅದನ್ನು ಬದುಕಿನ ಅವಿಭಾಜ್ಯ ಅಂಗವಾಗಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಲಿಂಗಭೇದವಿಲ್ಲದ ಸಮಾನತೆಯ ಸಾಧನವಾಗಿ ಕಟ್ಟಿಕೊಟ್ಟ ಸ್ತ್ರೀ ಸಂವೇದನೆಯ ತಾತ್ವಿಕ ನೆಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಇಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಸ್ತೃತವಾಗಿ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ.

Review of development of palliative care education in Slovenia
abstractText: Abstract Background Palliative care education is essential for the development of integrated palliative care services. This study reviews the development and structure of palliative care education in Slovenia between 2012 and 2025, with particular emphasis on education for healthcare professionals. Methods We conducted a retrospective descriptive review using data from the Slovenian Medical Chamber and the Slovenian Association for Palliative and Hospice Care. Educational activities were analysed according to duration, target groups and participation, with additional examination of structured postgraduate programmes. Results Between 2012 and 2025, 23 courses of the 60-hour Step by Step programme enrolled 702 participants, including 375 physicians and 263 nurses. Of these, 179 physicians obtained the Diploma in Palliative Care and 118 nurses completed the theoretical programme requirements; 43 of these nurses also completed additional practical training. Six 40-hour seminars were completed by 178 residents, while 27 courses of the 15/20-hour From Theory to Practice programme attracted 566 participants. Mandatory 60-hour paediatric palliative care education involved approximately 120 paediatric residents, and six regional 10-hour courses attracted 247 healthcare professionals. Conclusions Palliative care education has expanded and diversified in Slovenia, but further integration into mandatory medical training and development of advanced supervised clinical training remain priorities.

title: Supramolecular Polymer Nanoparticles for Polymer Toughening
abstractText: Abstract Nanoparticle toughening of polymers has long been constrained by the inherent trade-off between strength and toughness. Here, we report a supramolecular polymer nanoparticle toughening strategy based on an H2G2-type monomer (H2G2-1). During epoxy curing, H2G2-1 undergoes in situ self-assembly into supramolecular polymer nanoparticles (H2G2-NPs), which serve dual roles: acting as physical cross-linking points for reinforcement, while their reversible host–guest interactions function as sacrificial bonds that dissociate under stress to dissipate energy. This strategy ensures uniform nanoparticle dispersion and excellent interfacial compatibility. Compared to neat epoxy, the H2G2-NPs-toughened epoxy exhibits a 92.6% increase in elongation at break, a 66.0% increase in tensile strength, and a 233% increase in toughness, achieving synergistic strengthening and toughening. This work provides a new strategy to make high-performance toughened polymers.

abstractText: Mục tiêu: Đánh giá thể tích các nhân xám dưới vỏ, thể chai và mối liên quan với OPRM1 rs1799971, DRD2 rs1800497 ở nam giới nghiện rượu mạn tính. Đối tượng và phương pháp: Nghiên cứu bệnh - chứng trên 92 bệnh nhân và 80 nam giới nhóm chứng tại Bệnh viện Quân y 103, từ 11/2023 đến 4/2026. Thể tích não được định lượng trên MRI 3D T1 bằng FreeSurfer 7.4.1; kiểu gen xác định bằng PCR-RFLP. ANCOVA hiệu chỉnh tuổi và tổng thể tích nội sọ; ANCOVA hai chiều đánh giá hiệu ứng kiểu gen và tương tác Nhóm × kiểu gen. Kết quả: Nhóm bệnh có thể tích thấp hơn ở 9/10 chỉ số; mức ảnh hưởng lớn nhất ở tổng thể tích nhân dưới vỏ (η²p=0,381), hạch hạnh nhân (0,351) và thể chai (0,316); nhân đuôi không khác biệt (p=0,339). OPRM1 rs1799971 không có hiệu ứng kiểu gen hoặc tương tác có ý nghĩa. DRD2 rs1800497 có hiệu ứng kiểu gen ở hạch hạnh nhân (p=0,042) và hồi hải mã (p=0,036); TT cao hơn CT ở hạch hạnh nhân (p=0,037) và cao hơn CC ở hồi hải mã (p=0,049). Tương tác Nhóm × kiểu gen có ý nghĩa ở thể chai (p=0,021; η²p=0,046), mức giảm bệnh - chứng ở CC lớn hơn CT (p=0,007). Kết luận: Nghiện rượu mạn tính liên quan với giảm thể tích phần lớn nhân xám dưới vỏ và thể chai. OPRM1 rs1799971 chưa cho thấy mối liên quan theo kiểu gen; DRD2 rs1800497 liên quan ở mức danh nghĩa với hạch hạnh nhân, hồi hải mã và gợi ý tương tác ở thể chai, cần được xác nhận trên mẫu lớn hơn. Phát hiện mang tính thăm dò, cần được xác nhận trên mẫu độc lập lớn hơn.

Sudden Sensorineural Hearing Loss: Current Evidence of Etiology, Management, and Prognosis
abstractText: Sudden sensorineural hearing loss (SSNHL) is an otologic emergency because if not recognized and promptly treated, it can result in permanent hearing loss, tinnitus, and reduced quality of life. Although 70% of SSNHL cases are idiopathic, it is potentially linked to vascular impairment, especially migraines. Currently, there is a standard guideline from the American Academy of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery (AAO-HNS) for SSNHL. However, the effectiveness of treatment is still uncertain. Moreover, there are still knowledge gaps in many aspects of SSNHL, such as the lack of a standardized measurement for hearing improvement and the lack of a definite timeline for salvage therapy. In this review, the current evidence of etiology, management, and prognostic factors of SSNHL is elaborated.

title: Complementary Feeding Practices among Children Aged 6-23 Months in Mumoni Ward, Kitui County, Kenya: a Community-Based Cross-Sectional Study
abstractText: Complementary feeding between 6 and 23 months is essential to meet children's increasing nutritional needs and support optimal growth and development. Inadequate complementary feeding contributes to childhood malnutrition, yet evidence on the quality and adequacy of feeding practices among young children in rural communities of Kitui County remains limited. This study assessed complementary feeding practices among children aged 6-23 months in Mumoni Ward, Kitui County, Kenya, focusing on minimum dietary diversity, minimum meal frequency, and minimum acceptable diet. A community-based cross-sectional study was conducted among caregivers and children aged 6-23 months. A multistage sampling procedure was used to select households from three sub-locations, and 317 mother-child pairs were targeted. Data were collected using interviewer-administered questionnaires incorporating the World Health Organization infant and young child feeding indicators. Complementary feeding practices were evaluated using minimum dietary diversity, minimum meal frequency, and minimum acceptable diet, while data were analysed using the Statistical Package for the Social Sciences version 26. Of the 317 targeted participants, 310 participated, representing a response rate of 97.8%; five questionnaires were incomplete, hence discarded, and 305 complete questionnaires were included in the analysis. Timely introduction of complementary foods at six months was reported for 60.3% of children, while 39.7% were introduced to complementary foods before six months. Minimum dietary diversity, minimum meal frequency, and minimum acceptable diet were achieved by 77.4%, 61%, and 47.9% of children, respectively. Minimum acceptable diet was substantially higher among breastfed children (57.8%) than among non breastfed children (3.6%). Grains, roots, and tubers constituted the most commonly consumed food group (84.3%), whereas flesh foods were the least consumed (19.3%). The findings indicate that although a considerable proportion of children achieve minimum dietary diversity and the minimum acceptable diet, gaps persist in the timely introduction of complementary foods, meal frequency, and consumption of flesh foods. Strengthening caregiver nutrition counselling and education is important to promote appropriate complementary feeding practices among children aged 6-23 months in the study area.

Integrasi Teknologi Digital Dalam Pembelajaran Tematik Terpadu Model Webbed Untuk Mengatasi Kesulitan Belajar Siswa Di Sekolah Dasar: Kajian Sistematis
abstractText: Tujuan – Penelitian ini mensintesis bukti mengenai kesulitan belajar dalam pembelajaran tematik terpadu di sekolah dasar, menelaah penggunaan teknologi digital, dan mengusulkan kerangka integrasinya dalam model Webbed. Desain/metodologi/pendekatan – Kajian literatur sistematis ini dilaporkan mengikuti PRISMA 2020 dan PRISMA-S. Penelusuran laman penerbit dan jurnal pada 25 Oktober 2026 mencakup publikasi periode 2021–2026. Satu penilai menyaring 70 rekaman unik dan menetapkan 13 studi inti: tiga mengenai kesulitan belajar, tujuh mengenai teknologi digital, dan tiga mengenai model Webbed. Penilaian menggunakan daftar periksa adaptasi lima butir, disertai sintesis naratif; 17 sumber tambahan mendukung metode dan teori. Temuan – Kesulitan mencakup pemahaman konsep lintas muatan, keterlibatan dan konsentrasi, serta keterampilan dasar membaca dan berhitung. Teknologi digital menunjukkan hasil menjanjikan terutama pada luaran proksi berupa capaian kognitif dan motivasi. Bukti langsung terbatas pada satu intervensi membaca; sebuah tinjauan mengenai peserta didik penyandang disabilitas menilai bukti yang dikajinya lemah. Tidak ada studi inti yang menguji pembelajaran Webbed berbantuan teknologi digital untuk menangani kesulitan belajar. title: Accurate Internal Conversion Rates from Mixed-Reference Spin-Flip Time-Dependent Density Functional Calculations
abstractText: Understanding organic luminescent molecules necessitates accurate evaluation of electronic transition rates between molecular states. Among all relevant electronic transition processes, the kinetic rate of internal conversion (IC) is the most difficult one to predict reliably. IC rates are commonly evaluated using Fermi’s golden rule (FGR), with the ground and excited states typically described by density functional theory (DFT) and time-dependent DFT (TDDFT), respectively. However, this conventional DFT-TDDFT protocol often leads to pronounced underestimations of IC rates. To address this limitation, we examined various factors that affect the IC accuracy and proposed a hybrid computational strategy: using mixed-reference spin-flip TDDFT (MRSF) for geometry optimizations and frequency analyses, and using TDDFT to calculate nonadiabatic coupling matrix elements. Tests on 13 representative systems demonstrate that this strategy generally yields IC rates in much closer agreement with benchmark values. This improvement is achieved without sacrificing computational efficiency or requiring additional corrective treatments. The origin of this enhancement was further investigated in subsequent detailed decomposition analyses of the calculated IC rates, through which it was attributed mainly to the more reliable description of vibrational contributions within the MRSF framework. Finally, we demonstrated another advantage of this MRSF-based strategy: accurate IC rate calculations do not rely on the choice of coordinate systems, which may break down in the DFT-TDDFT protocol for some systems. Overall, this work provides a practical and broadly applicable approach for accurate FGR-based IC rate calculations.

abstractText: Abstract Background One of the challenges of the healthcare system is providing care and support for patients and their families during the end-of-life stages and at the time of death. Death doulas have been proposed as a potential means of filling gaps in this care and providing a supportive role. Thus, gaining insight into palliative care team members’ perceptions of the death doula’s role and the outcomes of their work is essential. To this end, the present study aimed to explore the perceived duties of death doulas and the perceived outcomes of their role for end-of-life cancer patients, from the perspective of palliative care team members. Methods The data in this qualitative study were collected through semi-structured in-depth interviews with 14 members of the care team in 2023–2024. The participants were selected using purposive sampling with maximum variation and based on the inclusion criteria. The collected data were analyzed using a conventional content analysis approach with Graneheim and Lundman’s (2004) approach. Results The data analysis resulted in the extraction of 153 codes, 13 subcategories, 5 categories, and 2 overarching themes. The first theme, “companionship for a peaceful ending,” included increasing death literacy and providing support. The second theme, “the triple effect” encompassed dual effects on doulas, reduction of unnecessary treatments, and peace in the passage of death. Conclusions The findings of the present study add new information to the existing body of knowledge regarding palliative care team members’ perceptions of the death doula’s role and its outcomes, and draw a picture of the perceived duties of doulas at the end of life for cancer patients. These findings can be used to develop a practical guide on the perceived role of death doulas for managers of palliative care centers, and for health officials and policymakers.

Host–virus immune crosstalk and immune evasion mechanisms of African swine fever virus: recent progress and translational implications
abstractText: Abstract African swine fever (ASF), caused by African swine fever virus (ASFV), is an acute and highly contagious disease characterized by high fatality and rapid transmission and poses severe threats to the global pig industry. As a complex nucleocytoplasmic large DNA virus (NCLDV), ASFV has evolved sophisticated and highly efficient immune evasion strategies. It remodels the host immune microenvironment through multiple molecular mechanisms, inhibiting both innate and adaptive immune surveillance to sustained intracellular replication. Such potent immune evasion capacity constitutes the primary bottleneck restricting the development of safe and effective commercial vaccines. In this review, we summarize recent research progress and systematically delineate host innate and adaptive immune networks during ASFV infection. This review focuses on the core immune evasion mechanisms of ASFV, including the suppression of type I interferon production by antagonizing pattern recognition receptors (such as cGAS-STING and Toll-like receptor cascades) and the Janus kinase-signal transducer and activator of transcription (JAK-STAT) axis, the bidirectional regulation of nuclear factor kappa B (NF-κB) signaling and the NLR family pyrin domain containing 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome to manipulate inflammatory responses and programmed cell death, and the impairment of antigen presentation and lymphocyte activation. Moreover, this review elaborates on the temporal dynamics and synergistic effects of these immune evasion mechanisms, aiming to provide systematic theoretical insights into deciphering ASFV pathogenesis and facilitating novel vaccine development and anti-ASFV drug discovery.

title: Determinants of Cloud Storage Adoption in Indonesia: Integrating Positive Valence, Security, and Trust
abstractText: Cloud storage adoption in Indonesia remains under-researched, and prevailing technology-adoption models generally assume that user trust is a robust antecedent of adoption intention. Drawing on the positive Valence Framework, this study integrates two positive utility constructs—perceived ubiquity and perceived benefits—with security and trust to explain behavioral intention to adopt cloud storage. Survey data from 202 digitally literate Indonesian internet users were collected through Google Forms and analyzed using partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM); common method bias was assessed using Harman’s single-factor test and a full collinearity (VIF) assessment. Perceived benefits exerted the strongest effect on behavioral intention, followed by security and perceived ubiquity, whereas trust had no significant effect. Theoretically, the non-significance of trust indicates that, in an ecosystem dominated by a few globally legitimate providers embedded in users’ device platforms, trust operates as an assumed baseline rather than a differentiating criterion. This reframes trust from a direct antecedent to a boundary-conditioned, hygiene-type factor and refines the applicability of Valence- and TAM/UTAUT-based adoption models to developing digital markets.

title: Bone transport induces CGRP release from sensory nerves to promote angiogenesis and heal diabetic foot wounds in rats
abstractText: Abstract Diabetic foot ulcer (DFU) is a critical complication of diabetes, characterized by high recurrence rates, high disability rates, high mortality, and a significant socioeconomic burden. The tibial cortex transverse transport therapy, based on the tension-stress effect, has demonstrated significant efficacy in promoting the healing of DFUs; however, its underlying mechanisms remain incompletely elucidated. Recent evidence show calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) is important for tissue regeneration. However, its role in BT-mediated healing is still unknown. This study aimed to investigate whether and how sensory nerves participate in the process of BT-promoted DFU healing via the release of CGRP. A femoral BT model was established in diabetic rats, with concurrent creation of an ischemic and dorsal foot wound model on the ipsilateral hindlimb. Capsaicin was employed to ablate sensory nerves and block CGRP release. Animals were allocated into four groups: sham-operated group, external fixator group, BT group, and BT + capsaicin group. Wound healing rate, angiogenesis, and CGRP expression in the DRG and regenerated skin were assessed. Transcriptomic analysis was performed on healed skin tissue. In vitro, the effects of CGRP on tube formation ability, as well as on the expression of CD31, VEGFA, and FAK phosphorylation, were evaluated in HUVECs. The BT technique significantly promoted the healing of dorsal foot wounds in diabetic rats ( P < 0.05) and increased the count of newly formed blood vessels within the wounds ( P < 0.05). CGRP release from sensory nerve axons in the DRG and within the wounds was significantly increased ( P < 0.05). Following sensory nerve blockade by capsaicin, CGRP secretion decreased, and both angiogenesis and wound healing rates were significantly slowed ( P < 0.05). Transcriptome sequencing revealed that DEGs in the BT group were significantly enriched in the nervous system development and tube formation systems. In vitro experiments confirmed that CGRP promoted endothelial cell tube formation in a dose-dependent manner ( P < 0.05), upregulated the expression of angiogenesis-related proteins and genes such as CD31 and VEGFA, and promoted FAK phosphorylation ( P < 0.05). The bone transport technique promotes diabetic foot wound healing via a “nerve-vessel-regeneration” axis. CGRP secreted by sensory nerves mediates this process, potentially by enhancing angiogenesis through the CGRP-FAK-VEGF signaling axis.

title: Tears of Comfort and Discomfort
abstractText: Abstract In this article, I examine the role of tears in Augustine’s Confessions in the context of conversion and consolation through the lens of Erin Manning’s theory of minor gestures. In doing so, I offer a new reading of Augustine, where his conversion is not so much carried forward by a determined will as it is assisted by the automatic, non-volitional gesture of crying. The analysis focuses on the constitutive role of the body and emotions in Augustine’s accounts of being confronted with others’ conversions, his own hesitation about celibacy, and his grief over Monica’s death. I argue that, across these scenes, the acts of seeing, groaning, and crying function as inceptive and disruptive gestures that facilitate new and deepened attachments to God.

title: Acquired Laryngotracheal Stenosis Following Intubation for Acute Cardiac Events
abstractText: Abstract Objectives Acquired laryngotracheal stenosis (ALTS) is a complication after endotracheal intubation, associated with prolonged intubation and larger endotracheal tube size. However, the relationship with cardiovascular disease has not been explored. Methods We retrospectively reviewed adult patients diagnosed with acquired laryngotracheal stenosis after acute cardiac event intubation at Temple University Health System hospitals from 2013 to 2023. Acquired laryngotracheal stenosis patients after non-cardiac intubation served as controls. Endotracheal tube size and length of intubation were compared between the two groups. Results Ten patients developed acquired laryngotracheal stenosis in the study group compared to 21 control patients (0.27 percent vs. 1.23 percent; p < 0.0001). Groups did not differ in demographics or length of intubation. Acute cardiac event patients were intubated with a smaller endotracheal tube ( p = 0.023) and required fewer intubation attempts ( p = 0.04). Conclusions Acquired laryngotracheal stenosis incidence was lower after cardiac-related intubation, potentially due to a smaller endotracheal tube size and fewer intubation attempts, but additional factors may be responsible. title: Persepsi Ibu Rumah Tangga terhadap Dampak Program Makan Bergizi Gratis terhadap Status Gizi Balita
abstractText: This study aims to describe the perceptions of housewives regarding the impacts, benefits, constraints, expectations, and perceived effectiveness of the Free Nutritious Meal Program (MBG) on the nutritional status of toddlers at the Posyandu in Lueng Bata Village, Banda Aceh. The study used a descriptive qualitative approach with a phenomenological orientation. Data were collected through observation, questionnaires, interviews, and documentation. The questionnaire involved 24 respondents, while interview data were obtained from 10 housewives and 2 Posyandu cadres. The data were analyzed descriptively through data reduction, categorization, interpretation, and comparison among data sources. The findings show that housewives generally expressed very positive perceptions of MBG. The questionnaire recapitulation showed 57.71% of responses in the very good/very positive category, 33.33% in the good/positive category, and 8.96% in the fairly good/neutral category. Interview findings indicate perceived benefits in meeting toddlers' daily nutritional needs, improving appetite and physical activity, and reducing household food expenditure. The main constraints were limited menu variation and occasional delays in distribution. Respondents expected the program to continue consistently, with more varied menus, especially soupy dishes, child-friendly taste, and additional milk or healthy snacks. Overall, MBG was perceived as effective in supporting toddler nutritional status within the local Posyandu context.

title: مستوى القيادة التحويلية لتدريسي كلية التربية البدنية وعلوم الرياضة في جامعة الحمدانية
abstractText: يهدف البحث الحالي الى التعرف على مستوى القيادة التحويلية لدى تدريسي كلية التربية البدنية وعلوم الرياضة في جامعة الحمدانية، استخدم الباحثون المنهج الوصفي بالأسلوب المسحي لملائمته وطبيعة البحث، واشتملت عينة البحث على (37) تدريسي وتدريسية، ولأجل تحقيق هدف البحث استخدم الباحثون استبيان القيادة التحويلية المعد من قبل (الحرباوي، 2021) وتم التحقق من صدقه وثباته، وفي معالجة البيانات احصائياً تم استخدام الوسط الحسابي، الانحراف المعياري، ومعامل الفاكرونباخ، والنسبة المئوية، استخدم الباحثون الحزمة الاحصائية (SPSS)، توصل الباحثون الى الاستنتاجات التالية يمتلك التدريسيين في كلية التربية البدنية وعلوم الرياضة في جامعة الحمدانية مستويات مرتفعة وقدراً كافياً من القيادة التحويلية وأبعادها (التأثير المثالي، التحفيز، الاستثارة الفكرية، الاعتبارات الفردية، التمكين)، في ضوء الاستنتاجات التي تم التوصل اليها يوصي الباحثون ما يأتي تبني فلسفة التغيير واعتماد انماط جديدة من القيادة داخل اروقة الكلية كالقيادة التحويلية من اجل النهوض بالمستوى العام وتحسين مخرجاتها من خلال الخصائص التي تمتاز بها القيادة التحويلية، وإقامة دورات تدريبية مستمرة للتدريسين في كلياتهم للتعريف بخصائص القيادة التحويلية بهدف توظيفها وتحثهم على التقدم بالمزيد من العطاء داخل القاعات الدراسية.

title: Different Generation and Ionization Methods Reveal Naphthalene–Water Interaction in Clusters
abstractText: Abstract The interactions between naphthalene (Np) and water molecules play a role in astrochemistry and atmospheric chemistry. Mixed naphthalene–water clusters allow investigation of these interactions at the molecular level. We use different generation and ionization methods to study (Np)m(H2O)n clusters: (I) They are formed in charged (both positively and negatively) He nanodroplets (HND) after uptake of naphthalene and water molecules. (II) Free clusters are formed by supersonic expansions either (A) directly in coexpansion of naphthalene and water in Ar buffer gas, or (B) large naphthalene clusters are formed in supersonic expansion and they pick up individual water molecules. In experiment (II), the clusters are charged positively by electron impact ionization at 70 eV or negatively by electron attachment at ≈2 eV. All mass spectra, independent of cluster generation and ionization technique, show cluster ion series [(Np)m(H2O)n]± with a strong propensity for the magic n = 4 mass peak. The negative ion [(Np)m(H2O)n]− spectra of the clusters generated in HND (I) and in coexpansion (II.A) exhibit striking similarity, with n = 4 and 8 magic clusters. These findings are substantiated by theoretical calculations of the [(Np)m(H2O)n]+/0/– clusters. Complex information revealed by the experiment and calculations offers detailed insight into the naphthalene–water interaction.

abstractText: ಗಾಂಧಿ ಕೇವಲ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯಾಗಿ ಮಾತ್ರವಲ್ಲ, ಸಮಷ್ಟಿ ನೆಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಪ್ರಜ್ಞೆಯಾಗಿ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ, ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ, ರಾಜಕೀಯ, ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ವಲಯಗಳಲ್ಲೂ ತನ್ನದೇ ಆದ ಪ್ರಭಾವಗಳನ್ನು ಬೀರಿರುವುದನ್ನು ಗಮನಿಸಬಹುದಾಗಿದೆ. ಭಾರತದ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಸಂಗ್ರಾಮದ ಚಾರಿತ್ರಿಕ ಸನ್ನಿವೇಶವಾಗಲಿ ಆನಂತರ ಗಾಂಧಿ ಎಂಬ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿತ್ವ ಅನಾವರಣಗೊಂಡ ಬಗೆಯಾಗಲಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಮುಂದೆ ದಾಖಲಾದ ನೆಲೆಯಂತೂ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟವಾದದ್ದು. ‘ಗಾಂಧಿ’ ಎನ್ನುವ ಪ್ರಜ್ಞೆ ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯವನ್ನು ಬಹಳಷ್ಟು ಪ್ರಭಾವಿಸಿದೆ ಎಂದರೆ ತಪ್ಪಾಗಲಾರದು. ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಪೂರ್ವ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ಭಾರತದ ಕುರಿತ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ಬರವಣಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಮುಖವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣಸಿಗುವ ಪಾತ್ರ ಅಥವಾ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಪಾತ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರೇರಣೆಯಾಗಿ ನಿಂತಿರುವ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಅದು ಗಾಂಧಿ. ಹಾಗಾಗಿ ಗಾಂಧಿ ಕೇವಲ ಭಾರತದ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಸಂಗ್ರಾಮದ ಇತಿಹಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಾರಿತ್ರಿಕ ಪ್ರಜ್ಞೆಯಾಗಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಉಳಿಯದೆ, ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ಲೋಕದಲ್ಲೂ ತಮ್ಮ ಛಾಪನ್ನು ಮೂಡಿಸಿರುವುದು ಗಮನಾರ್ಹವಾದ ಸಂಗತಿ. ನವೋದಯ ಪೂರ್ವದಿಂದ ಆದಿಯಾಗಿ ಆಧುನಿಕ ಸ್ತ್ರೀವಾದ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದವರೆಗೂ ಗಾಂಧಿಯ ಕುರಿತಾಗಿ ಬಂದಿರುವ ಕತೆ, ಕವನ, ಕಾದಂಬರಿ, ನಾಟಕ ಇನ್ನಿತರ ಸೃಜನಶೀಲ ಹಾಗೂ ಸೃಜನೇತರ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರಗಳೇ ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಾಕ್ಷಿ. ಕನ್ನಡದ ಬಹುತೇಕ ಸಾಹಿತಿಗಳು ತಮ್ಮ ಕಾವ್ಯ ವಸ್ತುವಾಗಿಯೋ, ಕಥನ ವಸ್ತುವಾಗಿಯೋ, ನಾಟಕ ರಚನೆಯ ಭಾಗೀದಾರನಾಗಿಯೋ, ಕಾದಂಬರಿಗಳ ಪಾತ್ರವಾಗಿಯೋ ಕಾಣಿಸಿರುವುದು ಸೃಜನಶೀಲತೆಗೆ ಹಿಡಿದ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕೈಗನ್ನಡಿಯೇ ಸರಿ. ಈ ಸೃಜನಶೀಲತೆಯ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ವಿಸ್ತಾರವಾಗಿ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡುವ, ಅದಕ್ಕೊಂದು ಹೊಸ ತಾತ್ವಿಕ ಪರಿಪ್ರೇಕ್ಷ್ಯವನ್ನು ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಮೂಲಕ ಕನ್ನಡ ಜಾಯಮಾನ ಗಾಂಧಿ ಎಂಬ ವಿಶ್ವಾತ್ಮಕನನ್ನು ಕನ್ನಡಿಗೀಕರಿಸಿದ, ಪ್ರಾದೇಶಿಕಗೊಳಿಸಿದ, ಸಮಕಾಲೀನಗೊಳಿಸಿದ ಕ್ರಿಯೆಯನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟುಗೂಡಿಸುವ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಈ ಅಧ್ಯಯನವು ಮುನ್ನುಡಿಯನ್ನಿಟ್ಟಿದೆ.

abstractText: Đặt vấn đề: Một tỷ lệ đáng kể bệnh nhân nhồi máu cơ tim cấp không ST chênh lên (non-ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction- NSTEMI) có tắc nghẽn cấp động mạch vành thủ phạm. Xác định các yếu tố liên quan đến nhồi máu cơ tim có tắc nghẽn (occlusion myocardial infarction, OMI) có thể hỗ trợ nhận diện sớm nhóm bệnh nhân cần đánh giá xâm lấn và tái thông mạch vành kịp thời. Mục tiêu nghiên cứu: Xác định một số yếu tố lâm sàng và cận lâm sàng liên quan đến nhồi máu cơ tim có tắc nghẽn ở bệnh nhân nhồi máu cơ tim cấp không ST chênh lên Đối tượng và phương pháp nghiên cứu: Nghiên cứu cắt ngang, thu thập số liệu hồi cứu kết hợp tiến cứu trên 192 bệnh nhân từ 18 tuổi trở lên, được chẩn đoán NSTEMI và chụp mạch vành xâm lấn từ tháng 12 năm 2024 đến tháng 06 năm 2026, tại Khoa Tim mạch Can thiệp, Bệnh viện Nguyễn Tri Phương. Bệnh nhân được chia thành nhóm OMI và không OMI theo kết quả chụp mạch vành và tiêu chuẩn nghiên cứu. Các yếu tố liên quan được khảo sát bằng hồi quy logistic đa biến có hiệu chỉnh theo tuổi. Kết quả nghiên cứu: Trong 192 bệnh nhân, có 88 trường hợp OMI, chiếm 45,8%. So với nhóm không OMI, nhóm OMI có tỷ lệ béo phì (55,7% so với 27,9%), hút thuốc lá (75,0% so với 48,1%), đau ngực (85,2% so với 73,1%) và rối loạn vận động vùng trên siêu âm tim (77,3% so với 51,0%) cao hơn; nồng độ hs-TnI tại các thời điểm khảo sát cũng cao hơn có ý nghĩa thống kê. Trong mô hình hồi quy logistic đa biến, các yếu tố liên quan độc lập với OMI gồm béo phì (OR hiệu chỉnh = 2,87; KTC 95%: 1,41–5,84; p = 0,004), hút thuốc lá (OR hiệu chỉnh = 3,07; KTC 95%: 1,49–6,31; p = 0,002), rối loạn vận động vùng (OR hiệu chỉnh = 4,56; KTC 95%: 2,11–9,83; p < 0,001) và mỗi một bậc tăng phân độ Killip (OR hiệu chỉnh = 1,53; KTC 95%: 1,07–2,19; p = 0,019). Kết luận: OMI gặp ở gần một nửa số bệnh nhân NSTEMI được chụp mạch vành xâm lấn. Béo phì, hút thuốc lá, rối loạn vận động vùng trên siêu âm tim và phân độ Killip có liên quan độc lập với OMI.

title: Fire Bloom: Energy-Efficient Cluster-Based Routing Protocol for Scalable Wireless Sensor Networks
abstractText: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) have been used in smart agriculture, industrial automation, and environmental monitoring applications, which require efficient and reliable routing with energy efficiency. Particularly the selection and operation of the cluster heads (CHs) play significant role in the performance of the network. In this work, we introduce a scalable, reliable and energy efficient cluster-based routing protocol (Fire Bloom), which combines adaptive CH selection and energy-aware routing. The cluster map and the packet flow intensity map even show the communication loads on the base station. The packet delivery ratio (PDR) of Fire Bloom is 97.2%, which is 6–10% better than the competing protocols. Fire Bloom achieved a PDR greater than 91% under a scalability test with 100–500 nodes, which means it can maintain good performance as the density of the network becomes denser. Energy usage is roughly proportional to the traffic volume but lower than previously reported values. Near-linear scalability at runtime is also proposed: increasing the number of nodes from 100 to 1,000 took from 1.2 s to 14.1 s. In general, Fire Bloom lowers overall end-to-end delay, increases load balancing across CHs, boosts energy efficiency, and it is resilient to changes in network conditions and maintains successful packet delivery. These results prove that it is capable of scalable and energy efficient deployments of WSN’s

Understanding intercultural experiences of Nuad Thai (traditional Thai massage) through an ethical lens on employee well-being in human resource management
abstractText: Purpose Nuad Thai (Traditional Thai Massage, TTM) is a cultural heritage product recognized by the United Nations as a potential contributor to well-being and the current empirical research paper aims to develop an understanding of how Nuad Thai is experienced by employees working in intercultural contexts. Design/methodology/approach Our empirical inquiry adopts a humanistic HRM perspective as its ethical lens and engages principally with conservation of resources (CoR) theory as its explanatory framework. The study adopts a qualitative approach based on social constructionist and interpretivist ontology and epistemology. Data have been collected through semi-structured interviews conducted with Japanese executives working in Thailand and triangulated against participant observational data. The data have been studied using thematic analysis. Findings Respondents typically experienced Nuad Thai in both personal and interpersonal ways. The findings of the study reveal five well-being facets that have the potential for explicating employees' experiences of Nuad Thai. Research limitations/implications The research study was limited by design to Japanese executives working in Thailand and ways of extending the research are suggested. From a theoretical perspective, the findings contribute to employee well-being and HRM scholarship by contextualizing and refining CoR theory, while simultaneously supporting a humanistic HRM perspective that treats employee well-being as a legitimate concern in its own right. The findings demonstrate how resource replenishment may be experienced through a culturally embedded practice and interpreted across interconnected physical, mental, social, spiritual and financial well-being facets. The study also highlights the relevance of cultural heritage practices for addressing urgent contemporary ethical issues at the intersect of business and society. Practical implications The novel conceptualization of employee experience of Nuad Thai provides HRM managers with deeper understanding of a potential tool with which to manage stress in intercultural work situations. Social implications Drawing on extant scientific research and novel empirical data, the study supports HRM managers in offering Nuad Thai as an element of well-being approaches within organizations thereby underpinning ethical business contribution to wider society in relation to well-being aspects of United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 3. Originality/value Though extant HRM literature often mentions massage as a potential contributor to well-being, employees' experiences of it have been little researched to date. Drawing on qualitative evidence from foreign employees in Thailand, this study develops one of the first empirically grounded HRM understandings of Nuad Thai as a multi-faceted well-being resource. The study's value adds due to its theoretical contribution by contextualizing and refining CoR theory through demonstrating how culturally embedded practices may function as multi-faceted resource-replenishment mechanisms in intercultural employment settings.

title: Dupilumab in Pediatric Eosinophilic Esophagitis
abstractText: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES Dupilumab is an approved biologic therapy for eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE); however, real-world pediatric data remain limited. The aim of this study is to evaluate the effectiveness and safety of dupilumab in children with EoE enrolled in the international European Society for Paediatric Gastroenterology, Hepatology and Nutrition (ESPGHAN)-funded pEEr registry, with a focus on combined remission, treatment deescalation, and predictors of sustained response. METHODS DU-PED is a multicenter, retrospective cohort study including children with confirmed EoE treated with dupilumab in routine clinical practice. The primary outcome was combined remission at 6 and 12 months, defined as simultaneous clinical (≥75% Pediatric Eosinophilic Esophagitis Symptom Score [PEESS] v2.0 reduction or symptom resolution), endoscopic (EoE Endoscopic Reference Score [EREFS] ≤2), and histologic remission (<15 eos/high-power field [HPF]). Secondary outcomes included longitudinal changes in disease domains, treatment deescalation, predictors of remission, and safety. Multivariable logistic regression and ROC analysis were performed. RESULTS A total of 109 patients from 22 centers were included (median age 16 years; 75% male). Combined remission was achieved in 53% at 6 months and 86% at 12 months. PEESS v2.0, EREFS, and peak eosinophil counts significantly improved over time (P < 0.001). At 12 months, 81% of patients were receiving dupilumab monotherapy, and 94% reduced concomitant EoE-directed therapy. Higher baseline proximal eosinophil density was independently associated with a lower likelihood of sustained combined remission at 12 months (odds ratio 0.98, 95% CI 0.96–0.99). Dupilumab was well tolerated, with no treatment discontinuations. CONCLUSIONS In a large international registry-based pediatric cohort, dupilumab achieved high and durable rates of combined remission and enabled substantial treatment simplification, supporting its role as an effective long-term treatment strategy for pediatric EoE.

title: Computational Analysis of Ginsenoside Rb1 and Gastrodin Analogues for Neurogenesis-Related Activity in Ischaemic Stroke
abstractText: At the global stage, ischemic stroke remains a leading cause of mortality and long-term disability, with a disproportionate portion of this burden being borne by low-and-middle-income nations, and increasingly, the young productive population bracket. Ischemic stroke’s management has historically been constrained by considerable challenges in the form of narrow therapeutic windows, high treatment costs, and strict eligibility criteria for the institution of either of the only two treatment options available at the disposal of medics, with those being thrombolysis, and mechanical thrombectomy. Mounting evidence favourably positions pharmacological augmentation of endogenous neurogenesis as a compelling strategy capable of appreciably enhancing structural and functional brain repair following ischemic stroke. In this regard, a relatively unexplored source of neurorestorative agents is phytochemicals sourced from conventionally used traditional therapeutic plants. A computation-heavy framework integrating ligand-based virtual screening, target-based molecular docking, pharmacokinetic profiling, and in silico toxicology forecasting was employed in a bid to meet the study’s principal objective, which was to identify novel phytochemical analogues possessing superior neurogenic potential, and favourable pharmacokinetic and toxicological profiles to ginsenoside Rb1, and gastrodin. Ginsenoside Rb1’s structural complexity resulted in the compound only yielding 6 analogues from Swiss Similarity. For the most part, most of these analogues underperformed relative to the parent compound across critical parameters. The only parameters where some analogues managed to outperform ginsenoside Rb1 was GI (gastrointestinal) absorption, and Lipinski’s violations. Gastrodin on the other hand typified a simpler chemical structure and returned some 400 analogues, several of which posted superior results to gastrodin’s. A common challenge encountered with these analogues however was their inability to traverse the BBB (blood brain barrier). These findings highlight the potential of phytochemicals as candidates for further investigation into endogenous brain repair, though experimental validation is required before their neurorestorative relevance can be established.

abstractText: يهدف البحث الى التعرف على اثر استخدام اسلوب التطبيق الذاتي لتعلم مهارة الكبس من فوق الراس في التنس الارضي، وقد تكونت عينة البحث من طلاب المرحلة الثالثة في كلية التربية الرياضية، اذ وقع الاختيار على شعبتي (C-D) لتكونا المجموعتين التجريبية والضابطة. وقد استخدم البحث المنهج التجريبي لحل مشكلة البحث، وقد تم اجراء التكافؤ بين المجموعتين من خلال اربعة متغيرات هي (العمر، الوزن، الطول، عناصر اللياقة البدنية) وقد افترض البحث وجود فروق ذات دلالة معنوية بين المجموعة التجريبية التي استخدم اسلوب التطبيق الذاتي والمجموعة الضابطة التي استخدم الاسلوب التقليدي ولصالح المجموعة التجريبية واستخدم البحث الوسط الحسابي والانحراف المعياري واختبار (ت) للمجموعات غير المتساوية لإيجاد الفروق والتحقق من فرضية البحث. وكانت ابرز النتائج تحقق فرضية البحث، واوصى البحث بضرورة استخدام اسلوب التطبيق الذاتي في تعليم المهارات الرياضية المختلفة.

title: Integrating Generative Artificial Intelligence into Financial Management Teaching: An Instructional Design for Finance Leasing
abstractText: Financial Management courses often fall short in linking computational training with financing decision analysis. Taking finance leasing as a case, this paper explores how generative artificial intelligence (generative AI) can be brought into the classroom. The instructional design is built around a scenario in which a private hospital finances the purchase of medical equipment, and it connects rent calculation, comparison of financing alternatives, and scrutiny of decision conditions through a four-stage process: independent calculation, AI questioning, professional verification, and decision reconstruction. Students first carry out the calculations and form a preliminary financing judgment, then use generative AI to interrogate financing constraints and uncover the assumptions behind a plan, and finally verify the AI-generated content against financial principles to strengthen their argument. The design takes students' own judgments as the starting point of human-AI interaction and assigns AI the role of revealing and examining the conditions under which a financing plan holds, rather than making the decision for them. This approach offers a reference for bringing generative AI into accounting and finance courses.

title: ĐẶC ĐIỂM HÌNH ẢNH SOI CỔ TỬ CUNG Ở PHỤ NỮ NHIỄM HPV TYPE NGUY CƠ CAO TẠI BỆNH VIỆN ĐA KHOA QUỐC TẾ VINMEC TIMES CITY
abstractText: Mục tiêu: Mô tả đặc điểm hình ảnh soi cổ tử cung và khảo sát mối liên quan giữa nhóm HPV16/18 với mức độ bất thường trên soi cổ tử cung ở phụ nữ nhiễm HPV type nguy cơ cao. Đối tượng và phương pháp: Nghiên cứu mô tả cắt ngang trên 57 phụ nữ nhiễm HPV type nguy cơ cao được soi cổ tử cung tại Bệnh viện Đa khoa Quốc tế Vinmec Times City từ tháng 01 đến tháng 12 năm 2025. Kết quả: Tuổi trung bình là 34,7 ± 7,9 tuổi. Có 54/57 trường hợp (94,7%) được đánh giá đầy đủ theo tiêu chí soi cổ tử cung của nghiên cứu; SCJ quan sát hoàn toàn ở 45 trường hợp (78,9%). TZ1, TZ2 và TZ3 lần lượt chiếm 35,1%, 43,9% và 21,1%. Hình ảnh soi cổ tử cung bất thường được ghi nhận ở 43/57 trường hợp (75,4%). Biểu mô trắng sau bôi acid acetic là dấu hiệu thường gặp nhất (39/57; 68,4%), tiếp theo là chấm đáy mảnh (24,6%) và khảm mảnh (19,3%). Trong 43 trường hợp có hình ảnh bất thường, thay đổi độ 1 chiếm 58,1%, thay đổi độ 2 chiếm 39,5% và một trường hợp (2,3%) có hình ảnh nghi ngờ xâm lấn. Tổn thương quan sát được chủ yếu nằm trong vùng chuyển tiếp (39/43; 90,7%) và giới hạn ở một góc phần tư cổ tử cung (28/43; 65,1%). Tỷ lệ hình ảnh soi cổ tử cung độ 2 hoặc nghi ngờ xâm lấn ở nhóm HPV16/18 cao hơn nhóm không phát hiện HPV16/18 (13/20 [65,0%] so với 5/37 [13,5%]; p<0,001). Kết luận: Ở phụ nữ nhiễm HPV nguy cơ cao, hình ảnh soi bất thường chủ yếu là biểu mô trắng sau bôi acid acetic và thay đổi độ 1; TZ2 thường gặp nhất. Hình ảnh độ 2 hoặc nghi ngờ xâm lấn gặp nhiều hơn ở nhóm HPV16/18.

title: An exploratory remote pilot study of environmental risk factors for Lewy body dementia considering sex differences
abstractText: Abstract Lewy body dementia (LBD), including Parkinson’s disease dementia (PDD) and dementia with Lewy bodies (DLB), is a common dementia that currently lacks disease modification. While studies in Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s diseases underscore the contribution of environmental factors with sex differences, knowledge on LBD environmental risk factors remains limited. We conducted an exploratory remote pilot survey, including data on residential history, chemical exposure, smoking, and alcohol use, for people with LBD ( n = 130; 51 females, 79 males) and age-matched controls ( n = 124; 64 females, 60 males). Associations with LBD risk for each environmental factor were assessed in the overall cohort and stratified by sex and LBD subtype (DLB or PDD). Metal exposure was associated with a higher risk of LBD. Alcohol and smoking were associated with a higher risk, particularly for males; glue/adhesives and not living in the suburbs were associated with a higher risk, particularly for females. Environmental factors likely play a role in LBD with potential sex differences.

title: Machine learning-guided identification and experimental validation of novel transcriptomic biomarkers for schizophrenia
abstractText: Abstract Background Schizophrenia (SCZ) is a severe neurodevelopmental psychiatric disorder characterized by marked clinical heterogeneity, making objective diagnosis challenging. This study aimed to identify characteristic genes associated with SCZ using machine learning approaches and to evaluate their diagnostic potential while assessing model robustness and cross-dataset generalizability. Methods Five SCZ-related gene expression datasets were obtained from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database. Four datasets were integrated as a discovery cohort, whereas GSE62191 was retained for independent external validation. Batch effects were assessed before and after ComBat correction using principal component analysis and PERMANOVA. Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were identified, followed by Gene Ontology and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes enrichment analyses. Random Forest (RF) analysis was used to identify characteristic genes, and an Artificial Neural Network (ANN)-based molecular diagnostic model was constructed. Additional analyses included leakage-controlled repeated cross-validation, feature-selection stability, permutation importance, leave-one-dataset-out validation, comparison of binary and continuous-expression representations, and age- and sex-adjusted sensitivity analyses. Eight representative genes were further validated by RT-qPCR in peripheral blood mononuclear cells from 20 schizophrenia patients and 20 healthy controls. Results A total of 1,893 DEGs were identified, including 809 upregulated and 1,084 downregulated genes. RF analysis identified 20 characteristic genes associated with SCZ. Functional analyses suggested involvement in inflammation, autophagy, oxidative stress, and metabolic dysregulation. Batch-associated variation was markedly reduced after correction (PERMANOVA R², 0.980 to 0.033). The original ANN achieved AUCs of 0.975, 0.659, and 0.696 in the training, validation, and test cohorts, respectively, whereas leakage-controlled repeated cross-validation yielded a mean AUC of 0.695 ± 0.032. Leave-one-dataset-out AUCs ranged from 0.614 to 0.818, indicating study-level heterogeneity. The molecular diagnostic model achieved AUC values of 0.782 in the training cohort and 0.721 in the external validation cohort. Continuous-expression modeling showed similar cross-validated performance but better external performance than the binary representation. RT-qPCR confirmed the differential expression of BID , ABCG2 , NEUROD6 , CRHBP , BAG3 , TOLLIP , HSD11B1 , and ETV5 , consistent with the transcriptomic findings. Conclusions This study identified candidate transcriptomic biomarkers associated with SCZ and established a machine learning-based diagnostic framework. However, leakage-controlled and study-level validation demonstrated only modest and heterogeneous predictive performance, indicating that the identified gene panel should be considered exploratory rather than a clinically established diagnostic signature. Experimental validation supported the biological and translational relevance of the identified biomarkers, which require further confirmation in larger, independent, multicenter cohorts.

title: When, where, and in whom does recurrence occur after radical cystectomy for pathologically confirmed non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer? Implications for risk-adapted surveillance
PENGARUH WORD SEARCH PUZZLE TERHADAP DAYA INGAT MURID DALAM PEMBELAJARAN IPAS KELAS V DI UPTD SD NEGERI 074056 DAHANA HUMENE
abstractText: This research was motivated by the low retention and memory capacity of students in learning Natural and Social Sciences (IPAS) in elementary school. This study aims to analyze the significant effect and evaluate the effectiveness of using word search puzzle media on the memory of fifth-grade students at UPTD SD Negeri 074056 Dahana Humene. A quantitative pre-experimental approach with a one-group pretest-posttest design was employed. The theoretical framework was grounded in information processing theory, emphasizing memory retention enhancement through attention, encoding, storage, and retrieval phases. The population comprised 30 fifth-grade students selected entirely as samples through total sampling. Data were collected using a 20-item multiple-choice test verified for validity and reliability, then analyzed using the Shapiro-Wilk normality test, paired-sample t-test, and Normalized Gain (N-Gain) analysis. The results showed that the mean pretest score of 50.00 increased significantly to 81.67 on the posttest. Hypothesis testing via paired-sample t-test yielded a significance value (p-value) of 0.000 (p<0.05), confirming a statistically significant difference in students' memory performance before and after treatment. Furthermore, the average N-Gain score of 0.6523 was classified into the moderate effectiveness category. Thus, word search puzzles are proven to have a significant positive effect in enhancing students' memory retention in IPAS learning. ABSTRAK Penelitian ini dilatarbelakangi oleh rendahnya daya ingat peserta didik dalam pembelajaran Ilmu Pengetahuan Alam dan Sosial (IPAS) di sekolah dasar. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis pengaruh dan mengukur efektivitas penggunaan media word search puzzle terhadap daya ingat peserta didik kelas V di UPTD SD Negeri 074056 Dahana Humene. Pendekatan penelitian yang digunakan adalah kuantitatif dengan desain pra-eksperimen berbentuk one-group pretest-posttest design. Kerangka teoretis penelitian ini berakar pada teori pemrosesan informasi (information processing theory) yang menekankan penguatan retensi memori melalui tahapan atensi, pengodean, penyimpanan, dan pemanggilan kembali informasi. Populasi penelitian berjumlah 30 peserta didik kelas V yang seluruhnya dijadikan sampel melalui teknik total sampling. Data dikumpulkan menggunakan tes objektif pilihan ganda sebanyak 20 butir soal yang telah teruji validitas dan reliabilitasnya, kemudian dianalisis menggunakan uji normalitas Shapiro-Wilk, uji paired sample t-test, dan uji N-Gain. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa rata-rata skor pretest sebesar 50,00 meningkat secara signifikan menjadi 81,67 pada posttest. Hasil pengujian hipotesis dengan paired sample t-test memperoleh nilai signifikansi (p-value) sebesar 0,000 (p<0,05), yang membuktikan adanya perbedaan yang signifikan antara kemampuan awal dan akhir peserta didik. Peningkatan daya ingat peserta didik juga diperkuat oleh perolehan nilai rata-rata N-Gain sebesar 0,6523 yang berada pada kategori sedang. Dengan demikian, penerapan media word search puzzle terbukti berpengaruh secara signifikan dan efektif dalam meningkatkan daya ingat peserta didik pada pembelajaran IPAS.

title: Co-Design of a Low-Power RISC-V Processor and a Reconfigurable Neural Network Accelerator for Edge AI Computing
abstractText: The operational efficiency of the compact edge AI accelerator is susceptible to variations in network structure and data transmission speed. To address this issue, this study proposes a collaborative design scheme for digital integrated circuits. By adjusting the working mode of the computing array and coordinating with storage and power management, the operational efficiency of the accelerator is improved. The research tested three network models trained on the publicly available Digits dataset. The results showed that the average accuracy of integer reasoning ranged from 96.78% to 97.33%, and the average loss was at most 0.11 percentage points compared to floating-point reasoning. In a cost model with 64 processing units and 8 KiB memory, compared to a fixed array, this scheme reduced the inference delay by 14.83% to 18.74%, decreased the single-inference energy consumption by 6.86% to 8.81%, and increased the area by 7.58%. Further experiments demonstrated that reducing the waiting time between data transmission and computation plays a major role in improving operational efficiency. Allowing the computing array to flexibly adjust its working mode can also increase the utilization rate of processing units, but this improvement is still limited by data transmission capabilities. In the hardware resource allocation test, the scheme with 64 computing elements and 1 KB memory further reduced the area while keeping the power consumption basically unchanged. These results indicate that this design can balance operational efficiency and hardware overhead to a certain extent, but the specific effect still needs to be verified through actual hardware testing.

title: THAY ĐỔI GIẢI PHẪU CỦA ĐỘNG MẠCH ĐẠI TRÀNG PHẢI, ĐỘNG MẠCH ĐẠI TRÀNG GIỮA XUẤT PHÁT TRỰC TIẾP TỪ ĐỘNG MẠCH CHỦ: BÁO CÁO CA LÂM SÀNG VÀ ĐIỂM LẠI Y VĂN
abstractText: Mục tiêu nghiên cứu: 1. Mô tả ca lâm sàng thay đổi giải phẫu của động mạch đại tràng phải, động mạch đại tràng giữa xuất phát trực tiếp từ động mạch chủ (hiếm gặp). 2. Điểm lại Y văn một số thay đổi giải phẫu của hệ mạch đại tràng phải và đại tràng giữa. Phương pháp nghiên cứu: Mô tả hồi cứu (báo cáo ca lâm sàng). Kết quả nghiên cứu: Bệnh nhân (BN) nữ, 80 T. Tiền sử: Đái tháo đường (ĐTĐ). Lâm sàng: Đau 1/2 bụng phải kiểu bán tắc ruột 1 tháng, không sốt. Khám: Sờ thấy mass còn di động. Chụp cắt lớp: khối đại tràng phải kích thước 60-87 mm. Nội soi đại tràng (NSĐT): Khối đại tràng phải sùi loét hoại tử quanh chu vi gây hẹp. Sinh hóa: Đường máu 11,18 mmol/L. Tổn thương trong mổ: Ung thư đại tràng (ĐT) góc gan 8-8 cm, T4N2M0. Trong mổ không thấy động mạch đại tràng phải (ĐTP), động mạch đại tràng giữa (ĐTG) xuất phát từ động mạch chủ sau tụy, chạy xuống bờ dưới thân tụy, chia 2 nhánh phải và nhánh trái. Nhánh phải nối với nhánh lên của động mạch hồi đại tràng, nhánh trái nối với nhánh lên của động mạch đại tràng trái. Mổ cắt 1/2 đại tràng phải, thắt các mạch hồi đại tràng, nhánh phải của động mạch đại tràng giữa, vét hạch, nối hồi đại tràng ngang bên bên. Kết quả giải phẫu bệnh ung thư biểu mô tuyến nhày T4N0M0. Kết luận: Ca lâm sàng và điểm lại Y văn Việt Nam và thế giới cho thấy động mạch hồi đại tràng xuất hiện trong 100% các trường hợp. Động mạch đại tràng giữa có tỷ lệ xuất hiện cao (98-100%) tuy nhiên có các dạng lạc chỗ xuất phát từ động mạch thân tạng, động mạch lách, động mạch gan chung, động mạch tá tụy dưới, động mạch tụy lưng, động mạch vị tá tràng hay động mạch đại tràng trái, động mạch chủ (sau tụy, trên nguyên ủy của động mạch mạc treo tràng trên) hoặc xuất phát từ động mạch chủ giữa động mạch mạc treo tràng trên và động mạch mạc treo tràng dưới (Y văn gọi là động mạch mạc treo tràng giữa). Động mạch đại tràng phải có tỷ lệ xuất hiện thấp (10,7%-63,3%). Động mạch hồi đại tràng là mốc giải phẫu quan trọng, cơ sở cho phẫu thuật nội soi bắt đầu phẫu tích từ trung tâm ra ngoại vi theo phương pháp cắt toàn bộ mạc treo trực tràng (CME), thắt các mạch máu trung tâm (CVL) và nạo vét hạch.

title: Penile Epithelioid Hemangioma with Atypical Features Harboring a Novel FOS::ERG Fusion
abstractText: Abstract Epithelioid vascular neoplasms span a wide spectrum from benign hemangiomas to malignant angiosarcomas, creating significant diagnostic challenges due to overlapping histopathologic features. We present the case of a man in his 40’s with a 1.5 cm painless, well-circumscribed mass on the dorsum of the base of penis. Microscopically, it corresponded to an epithelioid vascular neoplasm with cytologic atypia, necrosis and noticeable mitotic activity. A conservative surgical approach was undertaken, and the local excision specimen revealed an ​epithelioid hemangioma with a novel FOS::ERG fusion. This first reported atypical epithelioid hemangioma harboring a FOS::ERG fusion highlights the importance of integrating clinical, histopathologic, and molecular findings to avoid misinterpretation of these indolent neoplasms as sarcoma. Recognizing this ​benign mimicker of malignancy is essential to prevent an unnecessary radical surgery.

title: Synthesis and comparative analysis of moringa and rice husk biochar via iodine adsorption method for surface area and pore structure characterization
abstractText: Abstract Surface area is a critical parameter governing biochar’s adsorption performance. Although the Brunauer-Emmett-Teller method is the standard for surface area determination, its requirement for specialized, expensive instrumentation limits accessibility, particularly in resource-constrained laboratories. The iodine adsorption method offers a simple, cost-effective alternative for estimating surface area and micropore volume, yet its applicability across different feedstocks and pyrolysis conditions remains insufficiently validated. This study addresses this gap by systematically comparing Moringa oleifera stem biochar (MBC) and rice husk biochar (RHB) using iodine adsorption across a wide pyrolysis temperature range (300–700 °C) to characterize surface area and pore structure in both materials. Results indicated that MBC pyrolyzed at 400 °C exhibited superior performance, achieving a maximum iodine adsorption capacity of 507 mg g⁻¹ and a specific surface area of 481 m² g⁻¹. In contrast, RHB pyrolyzed at 500 °C showed a maximum capacity of 240 mg g⁻¹ and a surface area of 228 m² g⁻¹, attributed to its silica-rich composition. Optimal adsorption for both biochars occurred at 0.0265–0.04 M iodine concentrations. Adsorption kinetics revealed that MBC reached equilibrium faster due to its well-developed microporous structure, achieving 90% capacity within 90 h, while RHB exhibited slower, sustained adsorption. Isotherm analysis confirmed MBC’s enhanced capacity and surface heterogeneity compared to RHB. This study provided the first systematic comparison of MBC and RHB using iodine adsorption for surface area and pore structure characterization. Beyond reporting adsorption capacities, this study presented detailed kinetic and isotherm analyses that reveal mechanistic differences between lignocellulosic (MBC) and silica-rich (RHB) biochars. The comparative analysis shows MBC consistently outperforms RHB, achieving approximately two-fold higher iodine-derived surface area. These findings establish iodine adsorption as a validated, low-cost characterization tool for evaluating surface area and pore structure across contrasting feedstock types.

title: CÁC YẾU TỐ DỰ BÁO ĐỘC LẬP SỐC TIM MUỘN Ở BỆNH NHÂN NHỒI MÁU CƠ TIM CẤP TẠI BỆNH VIỆN CHỢ RẪY
abstractText: Mở đầu: Sốc tim muộn là biến chứng nặng ở bệnh nhân nhồi máu cơ tim (NMCT) cấp. Bệnh nhân có thể chưa biểu hiện rối loạn huyết động rõ rệt khi nhập viện nhưng diễn tiến nhanh đến suy tuần hoàn trong quá trình điều trị. Vì vậy, nhận diện sớm các yếu tố dự báo có ý nghĩa quan trọng trong phân tầng nguy cơ và định hướng xử trí. Mục tiêu: Xác định các yếu tố lâm sàng, cận lâm sàng ban đầu dự báo độc lập sốc tim muộn ở bệnh nhân NMCT cấp. Phương pháp nghiên cứu: Nghiên cứu mô tả cắt ngang có theo dõi dọc trên 1.083 bệnh nhân NMCT cấp không có sốc tim tại thời điểm nhập viện, điều trị tại Bệnh viện Chợ Rẫy từ tháng 4/2025 đến tháng 4/2026. Sốc tim muộn được xác định trong thời gian nằm viện. Các dữ liệu lâm sàng, xét nghiệm, điện tâm đồ và siêu âm tim được thu thập tại thời điểm nhập viện. Kết quả: Sốc tim muộn xảy ra ở 55 bệnh nhân, chiếm 5,1%. Các yếu tố dự báo độc lập gồm tuổi tăng mỗi 10 năm (aOR 1,72; KTC 95%: 1,29–2,31), STEMI thất phải (aOR 35,50; KTC 95%: 7,56–166,71), huyết áp tâm thu giảm mỗi 10 mmHg (aOR 1,23; KTC 95%: 1,02–1,49), Killip II–III (aOR 3,10; KTC 95%: 1,51–6,40), BUN tăng mỗi 5 mg/dL (aOR 1,19; KTC 95%: 1,02–1,40), block nhánh phải (aOR 5,84; KTC 95%: 1,83–18,62) và LVEF giảm mỗi 5% (aOR 1,36; KTC 95%: 1,12–1,64). Kết luận: Sốc tim muộn xảy ra ở 5,1% bệnh nhân NMCT cấp. Tuổi cao, STEMI thất phải, huyết áp tâm thu thấp, Killip II–III, BUN tăng, block nhánh phải và LVEF giảm là các yếu tố dự báo độc lập. Nhận diện sớm các yếu tố này có thể giúp phân tầng nguy cơ, tăng cường theo dõi và xây dựng chiến lược điều trị phù hợp nhằm hạn chế diễn tiến sốc tim muộn.
