title: Metabolic and Lifestyle Characteristics of Abdominal Obesity in Urban Areas of Togo
abstractText: In Togo, overweight and obesity represent a major public health challenge. This study aimed to identify factors associated with abdominal obesity to design relevant preventive approaches for the Togolese population. It was a cross-sectional study among 834 adult’s representatives of urban regions. The Cochran formula determined the sample size. WHO criteria defined obesity, and IDF criteria (waist circumference >80 cm for women, >94 cm for men) defined abdominal obesity (AO). Participants were black Africans aged 15-59 years from multiple localities. The link between metabolic syndrome parameters, types of obesity, and AO was evaluated by adjusted Odds Ratio test. Among 834 participants, IDF-defined abdominal obesity affected 9.1% (n=34; 95% CI: 6-12.0%) of men and 53.9% (n=247; 95% CI: 49-59) of women. Among obese subjects (n=180), AO prevalence reached 78.3% (n=124/157; 95% CI: 71.1-84.6) in women and 68.2% (n=15/23; 95% CI: 45.1-86.1) in men (p<0.001). Abdominal obesity was strongly associated with hypertension in men (OR=12.00; 95% CI: 1.15-159.55; p=0.010). Type I obesity predominated (56.67%), with metabolic parameters worsening with severity; systolic blood pressure and triglycerides rose progressively from type I to III. This study provides essential data on general and abdominal obesity prevalence in Togo and highlights the importance of a sex-differentiated approach in prevention and management to optimize clinical outcomes and improve population cardiovascular health.

title: Physical Origins of Anion Recognition in Rationally Designed Receptors: Balancing Interaction Energy and Drug Score
abstractText: Abstract The rational design of synthetic anion receptors requires a detailed understanding of how different noncovalent interactions govern molecular recognition while maintaining physicochemical properties compatible with biological applications. In this work, density functional theory (DFT) calculations were employed to investigate the recognition of biologically relevant anions (acetate, chloride, and dihydrogen phosphate) by seven structurally distinct receptors. The analyses reveal that classical N–H···anion hydrogen bonds constitute the dominant contribution to the calculated interaction energy, whereas halogen bonding, C–H···anion contacts, and anion−π interactions provide secondary or cooperative stabilization depending on the receptor architecture. Complementary in silico ADMET, drug score, and toxicity analyses, integrated through a composite multicriteria ranking, identify receptor 7 as the system that best combines strong anion-binding affinities, predominantly arising from classical N–H···anion hydrogen bonding, with an excellent pharmacokinetic profile, full compliance with Lipinski’s criteria, and the absence of predicted mutagenic, tumorigenic, irritant, or reproductive risks. These findings establish quantitative relationships linking electronic structure, noncovalent interaction mechanisms, and pharmacological descriptors, providing mechanistic principles for the rational design of supramolecular receptors for biologically relevant anions. The transport ability of these receptors was not evaluated and would require experimental validation.

title: KẾT QUẢ PHẪU THUẬT NỘI SOI CHỈNH HÌNH CUỐN MŨI DƯỚI BẢO TỒN NIÊM MẠC Ở NGƯỜI BỆNH VIÊM MŨI MẠN TÍNH QUÁ PHÁT
abstractText: Mục tiêu: Mô tả đặc điểm lâm sàng và đánh giá kết quả phẫu thuật nội soi chỉnh hình cuốn mũi dưới bảo tồn niêm mạc ở người bệnh viêm mũi mạn tính quá phát. Đối tượng và phương pháp: Nghiên cứu mô tả loạt ca trên 51 người bệnh được phẫu thuật tại Khoa Tai Mũi Họng, Bệnh viện 19-8, từ tháng 10/2025 đến tháng 7/2026. Người bệnh được đánh giá trước phẫu thuật, khi ra viện và sau 4, 8, 12 tuần bằng thang điểm NOSE, VAS, gương Glatzel và nội soi mũi. Kết quả: Tuổi trung bình là 33,01 ± 12,07; nam giới chiếm 70,6%. Tất cả người bệnh có tắc nghẽn mũi mức nặng hoặc rất nặng theo NOSE; điểm NOSE trước phẫu thuật là 81,37 ± 9,43. Quá phát cuốn dưới độ III chiếm 72,5%; phẫu thuật hai bên chiếm 82,4%. Sau 12 tuần, điểm NOSE giảm còn 3,14 ± 3,99; VAS giảm từ 6,63 ± 0,97 khi ra viện còn 0,43 ± 0,75; chỉ số Glatzel tăng từ 3,25 ± 0,73 cm trước phẫu thuật lên 8,87 ± 0,62 cm (p < 0,001 giữa các thời điểm). Liền niêm mạc tốt đạt 98,0%, cuốn mũi nhỏ và khe mũi thông thoáng đạt 98,0%; 98,0% không dính. Kết quả chung tốt đạt 92,2%. Chảy máu sau mổ, phù nề nhiều và nhiễm trùng lần lượt gặp ở 9,8%, 11,8% và 2,0%. Kết luận: Phẫu thuật nội soi chỉnh hình cuốn mũi dưới bảo tồn niêm mạc cải thiện rõ triệu chứng, thông khí mũi và hình ảnh nội soi sau 12 tuần, với tỷ lệ kết quả tốt cao.

title: KARAKTERISTIK GAYA BAHASA PADA PUISI ROMANSA DAN PUISI RELIGIUS: KAJIAN STILISTIKA
abstractText: Comparative stylistic studies across poetic genres in Indonesia remain scarce, as previous inquiries predominantly focused on descriptive analyses of single texts or individual authors. This study aims to analyze and compare the stylistic characteristics of five Indonesian romance poems and five religious poems across four analytical dimensions: diction, sentence structure and repetition, symbolic systems, and aesthetic functions. A descriptive qualitative design was employed utilizing documentary techniques and close reading across a corpus of ten poems officially published between 1970 and 2025. The findings reveal that both genres utilize comparable stylistic devices, particularly metaphor, personification, hyperbole, and repetition, yet channel them toward contrasting aesthetic poles. Romance poetry directs metaphors and repetitions horizontally toward interpersonal emotional domains using micro-scale natural symbols, whereas religious poetry channels them vertically toward transcendental communion through macro-scale cosmic imagery. Consequently, thematic divergence fundamentally transforms the aesthetic function of poetic discourse from personal emotional resonance into contemplative spiritual reflection. ABSTRAK Kajian stilistika komparatif lintas genre puisi di Indonesia masih terbatas karena penelitian sebelumnya cenderung berfokus pada analisis deskriptif satu teks atau pengarang tunggal. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis dan membandingkan karakteristik gaya bahasa pada lima puisi romansa dan lima puisi religius Indonesia berdasarkan empat dimensi stilistika, yaitu diksi, struktur kalimat dan repetisi, sistem simbol, serta fungsi estetika. Pendekatan kualitatif deskriptif diterapkan dengan teknik dokumentasi dan pembacaan close reading pada korpus sepuluh puisi yang diterbitkan secara resmi antara tahun 1970 hingga 2025. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa kedua genre memanfaatkan perangkat stilistika yang setara, khususnya metafora, personifikasi, hiperbola, dan repetisi, namun diarahkan pada kutub estetika yang bertolak belakang. Puisi romansa mengarahkan metafora dan repetisi secara horizontal pada ranah afektif antarpribadi dengan simbol alam berskala mikro, sedangkan puisi religius mengarahkannya secara vertikal pada hubungan transendental dengan simbol kosmik berskala makro. Dengan demikian, perbedaan tema secara mendasar mentransformasikan fungsi estetika bahasa puitik dari luapan empati personal menjadi perenungan spiritual yang khusyuk.

title: Fabrication and Characterization of High-Temperature Superconducting \({Bi_{2-x}Pb_xSr_2Ca_2Cu_3O_{10+\gamma}}\) Tapes
abstractText: This work reports the fabrication and comprehensive characterization of \({Bi_{2-x}Pb_xSr_2Ca_2Cu_3O_{10+\gamma}}\) superconducting tapes with coexistence of Pb-doped Bi-2223 and Bi-2212 phases, embedded in a high-purity silver matrix. The tapes were produced by the powder-in-tube (PIT) method, followed by heat treatments at 865 and 810 °C and mechanical lamination, yielding homogeneous tapes with a thickness of about 0.6 mm. Structural analysis by X-ray diffraction shows that the precursor powder consists mainly of the BPSCCO-2223 phase and a carbonate secondary phase, whereas the tape core additionally contains the BPSCCO-2212 phase, \({Ca_2PbO_4}\) and \({Ca_{2.675}Cu_3Pb_{0.535}Sr_{2.675}Bi_{1.6}O_x}\). SEM-EDS confirms the flattening and alignment of grains after rolling, the presence of Ca- and Pb-rich secondary phases, and the absence of detectable silver diffusion into the core. DC susceptibility measurements under 50 and 1000 Oe reveal two superconducting transitions in the core, associated with the 2223 and 2212 phases, and a clear reduction of the irreversibility temperature with respect to the powder. From hysteresis loops, the critical fields (\({H_{C1}}\) and \({H_{irr}}\)) and the vortex-matter \(B-T\) phase diagrams were constructed, showing a shift of the irreversibility line to lower fields and temperatures for the tape core. The critical current density estimated with the Bean model reaches values of the order of \({10^5\ A/cm^2}\) at 10 K for the tape core, with the enhancement attributed to grain alignment and secondary-phase pinning. Magnetic relaxation measurements show a complex, two-plateau decay in the core at 5 K, attributed to the competition between the coexisting 2223 and 2212 phases. The results provide a complete picture of the microstructural, magnetic and transport behaviour of Pb-doped Bi-2223 tapes and establish a basis for their optimisation.

abstractText: Mục tiêu: Mô tả sự thay đổi chất lượng sẹo sớm và phân tích một số yếu tố liên quan đến chất lượng sẹo sau phẫu thuật tạo hình vùng mặt. title: Benchmarking Machine Learning Models for Viral Nanobody Epitope Prediction
abstractText: Abstract Rapid development of therapeutics against emerging viral pathogens increasingly depends on machine learning (ML), both to generate candidate binders and for structural validation. Nanobodies (Nbs), or single-domain antibodies, are promising antiviral therapeutics, but accurate in silico prediction of viral epitopes remains challenging. Here we benchmark three ML-based structure prediction models, Boltz-2, Chai-1 and AlphaFold3 (AF3), against a curated data set of viral antigen-nanobody complexes deposited after the AF3 training cutoff. AF3 outperformed the other models: success (interface DockQ > 0.23) rose from 33% with a single seed to 50% and 65% with 10 and 100 seeds-per-target, respectively, compared with 18% for Boltz-2 and 30% for Chai-1. Using an expanded data set, we evaluated confidence metrics and found that a strict ipTM cutoff of 0.8, or a combination of ipTM ≥ 0.6 with a CDR3 loop pLDDT ≥ 60, reliably excluded incorrect predictions while retaining most successful ones. We further establish best practices for two AF3-specific capabilities, the choice of antigen multimeric state and the inclusion of N-glycosylation, both of which can be decisive for epitope success depending on the target. Finally, we apply these guidelines to two design problems: ranking a library of VEEV-neutralizing nanobodies and mapping the epitope of the broadly neutralizing nanobody CC3 across homologous alphavirus antigens. These results provide a practical framework for ML-based viral nanobody epitope prediction and design.

title: ĐẶC ĐIỂM LÂM SÀNG, CẬN LÂM SÀNG UNG THƯ BIỂU MÔ TUYẾN GIÁP THỂ NHÚ Ở BỆNH NHÂN ≥55 TUỔI TẠI BỆNH VIỆN K
abstractText: Mục tiêu: Mô tả một số đặc điểm lâm sàng, cận lâm sàng của ung thư biểu mô tuyến giáp thể nhú ở bệnh nhân ≥55 tuổi được điều trị phẫu thuật tại Bệnh viện K. Đối tượng và phương pháp nghiên cứu: Nghiên cứu mô tả tiến cứu trên 236 bệnh nhân từ 55 tuổi trở lên được chẩn đoán ung thư biểu mô tuyến giáp thể nhú tại Bệnh viện K. Các thông tin về đặc điểm lâm sàng, siêu âm tuyến giáp và kết quả tế bào học được thu thập, xử lý và phân tích bằng phần mềm SPSS. Kết quả: Tuổi trung bình của nhóm nghiên cứu là 62,2 ± 5,8 tuổi, dao động từ 55 đến 79 tuổi; nữ giới chiếm tỷ lệ 81,8%. Phần lớn bệnh nhân được phát hiện bệnh tình cờ thông qua khám sức khỏe định kỳ (78,8%). Qua thăm khám lâm sàng, 71,2% bệnh nhân sờ thấy khối u tuyến giáp. Có 36 bệnh nhân phát hiện hạch cổ trên lâm sàng, chiếm 15,3%, chủ yếu thuộc nhóm hạch cổ bên. Trên siêu âm, kích thước u trung bình là 10,9 ± 8,1 mm; trong đó, phần lớn khối u có kích thước ≤10 mm (66,9%). Vị trí u tại thùy phải chiếm tỷ lệ cao nhất (44,1%), tiếp theo là thùy trái (36,4%). Đa số bệnh nhân có một khối u tuyến giáp, chiếm 84,3%. Theo phân loại ACR TI-RADS 2017, TI-RADS 5 được ghi nhận ở 129 bệnh nhân (54,7%), trong khi TI-RADS 4 chiếm 45,3%. Kết quả tế bào học chọc hút kim nhỏ chủ yếu thuộc nhóm Bethesda V và Bethesda VI, lần lượt chiếm 55,9% và 44,1%. Bệnh lý nội khoa kèm theo được ghi nhận ở 46,6% bệnh nhân. Kết luận: Ung thư biểu mô tuyến giáp thể nhú ở bệnh nhân ≥55 tuổi gặp chủ yếu ở nữ giới và thường được phát hiện tình cờ qua khám sức khỏe định kỳ. Phần lớn khối u có kích thước nhỏ, đa số có một tổn thương trên siêu âm và nằm ở một thùy tuyến giáp. Các tổn thương trên siêu âm chủ yếu được xếp loại TIRADS 4 hoặc TIRADS 5, trong khi kết quả tế bào học tập trung ở nhóm Bethesda V và Bethesda VI. Việc nhận diện các đặc điểm này có ý nghĩa trong chẩn đoán và lựa chọn chiến lược điều trị phù hợp cho người bệnh.

title: PENGEMBANGAN MEDIA BIG BOOK BERBASIS KEARIFAN LOKAL UNTUK MENINGKATKAN MINAT BACA PESERTA DIDIK KELAS V UPTD SD NEGERI 070975 GUNUNGSITOLI
abstractText: This study aims to describe the development process of a local wisdom-based big book learning media, analyze its feasibility based on expert validations, evaluate its practicality from teacher and student responses, and determine its initial effectiveness in improving the reading interest of fifth-grade students. This research and development study employed the ADDIE model (analysis, design, development, implementation, evaluation). The study population comprised all 20 fifth-grade students at UPTD SD Negeri 070975 Gunungsitoli, who were engaged through a total sampling technique divided into a small-group trial of 5 students and a field trial of 15 students. Data were collected using expert validation sheets, practicality response questionnaires for both the teacher and students, and reading interest questionnaires (administered as pre-test and post-test) covering four core indicators: attention, pleasure, persistence, and willingness to read. Expert validation results demonstrated high feasibility scores: 93.7% from the media expert (very valid), 85.0% from the subject matter expert (very valid), and 98.0% from the language expert (very valid). Practicality assessments yielded 83.0% in the small-group trial, 86.5% in the field trial, and 97.0% from the classroom teacher, all falling into the highly practical category. The initial effectiveness test showed a substantial increase in students' reading interest scores, rising from 47.5% at the pre-test (low category) to 92.8% at the post-test (very high category). Consequently, this bilingual big book accompanied by shared reading guidelines is proven feasible, practical, and preliminarily effective for enhancing elementary school students' reading engagement with local culture materials. ABSTRAK Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mendeskripsikan proses pengembangan media pembelajaran big book berbasis kearifan lokal Nias, menganalisis kelayakan produk berdasarkan validasi ahli, mengukur tingkat kepraktisan dari respons guru dan peserta didik, serta mengetahui efektivitas awal media dalam meningkatkan minat baca peserta didik kelas V. Penelitian dan pengembangan ini menerapkan model ADDIE (analysis, design, development, implementation, evaluation). Populasi penelitian adalah seluruh peserta didik kelas V UPTD SD Negeri 070975 Gunungsitoli sebanyak 20 orang yang sekaligus dijadikan sampel jenuh, dengan pembagian 5 peserta didik pada uji coba kelompok kecil dan 15 peserta didik pada uji coba lapangan. Instrumen pengumpulan data berupa lembar validasi ahli, angket respons kepraktisan guru dan peserta didik, serta angket minat baca (pretest dan posttest) dengan empat indikator utama, yaitu perhatian, kesenangan, ketekunan, dan kemauan memilih bahan bacaan. Hasil validasi ahli menunjukkan persentase sebesar 93,7% dari ahli media (kategori sangat valid), 85,0% dari ahli materi (kategori sangat valid), dan 98,0% dari ahli bahasa (kategori sangat valid). Tingkat kepraktisan media mencapai 83,0% pada uji coba kelompok kecil, 86,5% pada uji coba lapangan, serta 97,0% dari respons guru pamong (seluruhnya berkategori sangat praktis). Pengukuran efektivitas awal memperlihatkan peningkatan persentase minat baca dari 47,5% pada saat pretest (kategori rendah) menjadi 92,8% pada saat posttest (kategori sangat tinggi). Dengan demikian, media big book dwibahasa berbantuan metode shared reading ini terbukti layak, praktis, dan efektif secara terbatas untuk menumbuhkan minat baca materi muatan lokal di sekolah dasar.

title: Peningkatan Pemahaman Santri Pondok Pesantren Al-Muntaha Salatiga Terhadap UU Nomor 23 Tahun 2004 Tentang Penghapusan KDRT
abstractText: Rumah tangga pada hakikatnya merupakan lingkungan yang diharapkan mampu memberikan ketenteraman (sakinah) bagi setiap anggotanya. Akan tetapi, tindakan kekerasan dalam rumah tangga masih kerap terjadi sehingga lingkungan yang seharusnya menjadi ruang paling aman dan privat justru dapat memberikan dampak negatif terhadap proses pertumbuhan dan perkembangan anak. Pengabdian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui pemahaman santri Pondok Pesantren Al-Muntaha Salatiga tentang Undang-Undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2004 tentang Penghapusan Kekerasan dalam Rumah Tangga serta strategi penyuluhan hukum yang dapat diterapkan di pondok pesantren tersebut. Pendekatan pengabdian yang digunakan adalah PAR (Participatory Action Research) dengan melibatkan santri Al-Muntaha Salatiga sebagai peserta. Kegiatan ini dilaksanakan melalui empat tahap, yaitu perencanaan, tindakan, pengamatan dan refleksi. Hasil pengabdian menunjukkan bahwa kegiatan ini berhasil mencapai target yang telah direncanakan. Penyuluhan hukum mengenai Undang-Undang Penghapusan Kekerasan dalam Rumah Tangga menunjukkan adanya peningkatan pemahaman santri. Dari total 60 peserta, jumlah santri yang memahami materi meningkat dari 15 orang (25%) sebelum penyuluhan menjadi 50 orang (83,3%) setelah kegiatan dilaksanakan. Strategi yang efektif untuk mencegah terjadinya kekerasan dalam rumah tangga salah satunya dengan cara memberikan penyuluhan hukum kepada para remaja, sebab para remaja masih banyak yang belum paham tentang Undang-Undang PKDRT yang ada.

title: Temperature-Dependent Interaction Studies of Choline–Levulinic Acid Deep Eutectic Solvent with Methanol and Ethanol: Combined Experimental and Density Functional Theory Study
abstractText: Abstract Deep eutectic solvents have gained significant attention in recent years as sustainable alternatives to conventional solvents, owing to their eco-friendly nature and advantageous properties over traditional organic solvents and ionic liquids. This study evaluates the physicochemical and thermodynamic properties of a choline chloride:levulinic acid DES prepared at a 1:2 molar ratio. Densities, speed of sound, and refractive indices of pure DES and its binary mixtures with methanol and ethanol were measured across the entire mole composition range of DES (xDES = 0.0000:1.0000) at different temperatures ranging from 293.15 to 313.15 K. The experimental data was modeled using the Lorentz–Lorenz equation, confirming its accuracy in predicting the measured properties and excess molar volumes. The excess molar volumes (VmE), intermolecular free length (Lf), isentropic compressibilities (κs), deviations in isentropic compressibilities (Δκs), and deviation refractive indices (ΔnD) were calculated to elucidate the intermolecular interactions between the DES and alcohols. The density functional theory (DFT) approach was used to support and evaluate the intermolecular interactions between the DES mixtures with selected alcohols and strong interactions were also observed. The DFT calculations, supplemented by noncovalent interactions (NCI) and reduced density gradient (RDG) analyses, were performed to elucidate the intermolecular interactions within DES-alcohol systems.

title: PENGARUH MODEL PjBL BERBASIS DIGITALISASI TERHADAP LITERASI SAINS SISWA PADA PEMBELAJARAN IPAS SDN 3 SEKARTEJA
abstractText: This study aims to determine the effect of the digitalization-based Project-Based Learning (PjBL) model on the science literacy of fifth-grade students in Science and Social Studies (IPAS) learning on the topic of water cycle changes at SDN 3 Sekarteja. This study employed a quantitative quasi-experimental approach with a nonequivalent control group pretest-posttest design. The sample was selected using a purposive sampling technique, consisting of class V B as the experimental class (18 students) receiving the digitalization-based PjBL model with animated videos, and class V A as the control class (18 students) receiving conventional instruction. Data were gathered through a multiple-choice science literacy test and student activity observation sheets. The results showed that the experimental class achieved a higher posttest mean score of 75.18 compared to 57.79 in the control class, with average N-Gain scores of 0.50 and 0.33, respectively, both falling into the moderate category. Hypothesis testing on the posttest data yielded a significance value of 0.003 and on the N-Gain data of 0.025 (p<0.05), confirming a statistically significant difference between both classes. The pretest data indicated no significant initial difference between the groups (p=0.087), confirming that post-treatment achievements were attributable to the intervention. Consequently, the digitalization-based PjBL model is proven effective in enhancing elementary students' science literacy. ABSTRAK Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui pengaruh model Project-Based Learning (PjBL) berbasis digitalisasi terhadap literasi sains siswa kelas V pada pembelajaran IPAS materi perubahan siklus air di SDN 3 Sekarteja. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif jenis eksperimen semu (quasi-experiment) dengan desain nonequivalent control group pretest-posttest design. Sampel ditentukan melalui teknik purposive sampling, terdiri atas kelas V B sebagai kelas eksperimen (18 siswa) yang memperoleh model PjBL berbantuan media video animasi digital serta kelas V A sebagai kelas kontrol (18 siswa) dengan pembelajaran konvensional. Data dikumpulkan menggunakan instrumen tes literasi sains pilihan ganda serta lembar observasi aktivitas belajar siswa. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan nilai rata-rata post-test kelas eksperimen mencapai 75,18, sedangkan kelas kontrol memperoleh 57,79 dengan perolehan N-Gain masing-masing sebesar 0,50 dan 0,33 dalam kategori sedang. Uji hipotesis data post-test menghasilkan nilai signifikansi 0,003 dan pada data N-Gain sebesar 0,025 (p<0,05), yang membuktikan adanya perbedaan capaian yang signifikan antara kedua kelas. Data pretest kedua kelompok menunjukkan tidak ada perbedaan kemampuan awal yang signifikan (p=0,087), sehingga keunggulan akhir dapat diatribusikan pada perlakuan model. Dengan demikian, penerapan model PjBL berbasis digitalisasi terbukti efektif meningkatkan literasi sains siswa sekolah dasar secara nyata.

title: Simulated Feature Fusion for Parkinson’s Disease Prediction Using Non-aligned Public Handwriting and Voice Datasets
abstractText: Parkinson’s disease (PD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that affects over 10 million people worldwide, with prevalence increasing due to aging populations. Early symptoms such as tremor, micrographia, bradykinesia, and voice changes often remain undetected until substantial neuronal loss has occurred, leading to irreversible damage and increased treatment costs. This paper presents a comparative study of five machine learning models—Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Support Vector Machine (RBF Kernel), K-Nearest Neighbors, and XGBoost—for Parkinson’s disease prediction using handwriting and voice-based features. Performance was evaluated using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, AUC, 5-fold cross-validation, ROC curve analysis, feature importance analysis, and SHAP-based explainability.XGBoost achieved the highest test-set F1-score (0.7407) and AUC (0.8329), while SVM achieved the highest average cross-validation F1-score. Decision-level fusion further improved recall (0.88) while maintaining competitive overall performance. K-Nearest Neighbors produced the lowest overall performance, while XGBoost achieved the best balance between classification accuracy, F1-score, and AUC.

abstractText: Mục tiêu: Mô tả đặc điểm hình ảnh siêu âm ở bệnh nhân dọa sẩy thai tại Bệnh viện Đa khoa Quốc tế Vinmec Times City. Đối tượng và phương pháp: Nghiên cứu mô tả cắt ngang trên 59 bệnh nhân được chẩn đoán dọa sẩy thai và khám, siêu âm tại Bệnh viện Đa khoa Quốc tế Vinmec Times City trong thời gian từ tháng 01 năm 2025 đến tháng 12 năm 2025. Kết quả: Tuổi trung bình của đối tượng nghiên cứu là 29,8 ± 4,8 tuổi; nhóm 25–34 tuổi chiếm 61,0%. Siêu âm xác định 100% trường hợp có thai trong buồng tử cung, 94,9% có phôi và hoạt động tim thai. Tuổi thai trung bình 8,1 ± 1,5 tuần, CRL 16,8 ± 7,9 mm và tần số tim thai 161,4 ± 18,7 lần/phút. Tụ máu dưới màng đệm gặp ở 23,7% trường hợp, chủ yếu kích thước nhỏ (64,3%) và nằm cạnh túi thai (71,4%). Cổ tử cung đóng ở 98,3% trường hợp. Kết luận: Siêu âm có giá trị trong đánh giá toàn diện thai sớm ở bệnh nhân dọa sẩy thai, giúp xác định vị trí thai, tình trạng sống và các đặc điểm hình thái liên quan, qua đó hỗ trợ định hướng theo dõi và hạn chế chẩn đoán dựa trên một dấu hiệu đơn độc.
